text_en: Tobias of the tribe and city of Nephtali , (which is in the upper parts of Galilee above Naasson, beyond the way that leads to the west, having on the right hand the city of Sephet),
text_la: Tobias ex tribu et civitate Nephthali (quæ est in superioribus Galilææ supra Naasson, post viam quæ ducit ad occidentem, in sinistro habens civitatem Sephet)
text_pt: E sucedeu nos dias de Assuero, o Assuero que reinou desde a India até a Etiópia, sobre cento e vinte e sete províncias,
text_el: βίβλος λόγων Τωβιτ τοῦ Τωβιηλ τοῦ Ανανιηλ τοῦ Αδουηλ τοῦ Γαβαηλ ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Ασιηλ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλιμ

text_en: when he was made captive in the days of Salmanasar king of the Assyrians , even in his captivity, forsook not the way of truth ,
text_la: cum captus esset in diebus Salmanasar regis Assyriorum, in captivitate tamen positus, viam veritatis non deseruit,
text_pt: Que, naqueles dias, assentando-se o rei Assuero no trono do seu reino, que estava na fortaleza de Susã,
text_el: ὃς ᾐχμαλωτεύθη ἐν ἡμέραις Ενεμεσσαρου τοῦ βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων ἐκ Θισβης ἥ ἐστιν ἐκ δεξιῶν Κυδιως τῆς Νεφθαλιμ ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ ὑπεράνω Ασηρ

text_en: but every day gave all he could get to his brethren his fellow captives, that were of his kindred.
text_la: ita ut omnia quæ habere poterat, quotidie concaptivis fratribus, qui erant ex ejus genere, impertiret.
text_pt: No terceiro ano do seu reinado, fez um banquete a todos os seus príncipes e seus servos, estando assim perante ele o poder da Pérsia e Média e os nobres e príncipes das províncias,
text_el: ἐγὼ Τωβιτ ὁδοῖς ἀληθείας ἐπορευόμην καὶ δικαιοσύνης πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου καὶ ἐλεημοσύνας πολλὰς ἐποίησα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου καὶ τῷ ἔθνει τοῖς συμπορευθεῖσιν μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς χώραν Ἀσσυρίων εἰς Νινευη

text_en: And when he was younger than any of the tribe of Nephtali , yet did he no childish thing in his work.
text_la: Cumque esset junior omnibus in tribu Nephthali, nihil tamen puerile gessit in opere.
text_pt: Para mostrar as riquezas da glória do seu reino, e o esplendor da sua excelente grandeza, por muitos dias, a saber: cento e oitenta dias.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἤμην ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ μου ἐν τῇ γῇ Ισραηλ νεωτέρου μου ὄντος πᾶσα φυλὴ τοῦ Νεφθαλιμ τοῦ πατρός μου ἀπέστη ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου Ιεροσολύμων τῆς ἐκλεγείσης ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ εἰς τὸ θυσιάζειν πάσας τὰς φυλάς καὶ ἡγιάσθη ὁ ναὸς τῆς κατασκηνώσεως τοῦ ὑψίστου καὶ ᾠκοδομήθη εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: Moreover when all went to the golden calves which Jeroboam king of Israel had made, he alone fled the company of all,
text_la: Denique, cum irent omnes ad vitulos aureos quos Jeroboam fecerat rex Israël, hic solus fugiebat consortia omnium.
text_pt: E, acabados aqueles dias, fez o rei um banquete a todo o povo que se achava na fortaleza de Susã, desde o maior até ao menor, por sete dias, no pátio do jardim do palácio real.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ αἱ συναποστᾶσαι ἔθυον τῇ Βααλ τῇ δαμάλει καὶ ὁ οἶκος Νεφθαλιμ τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: and went to Jerusalem to the temple of the Lord , and there adored the Lord God of Israel , offering faithfully all his firstfruits , and his tithes ,
text_la: Sed pergebat in Jerusalem ad templum Domini, et ibi adorabat Dominum Deum Israël, omnia primitiva sua et decimas suas fideliter offerens,
text_pt: As tapeçarias eram de pano branco, verde, e azul celeste, pendentes de cordões de linho fino e púrpura, e argolas de prata, e colunas de mármore; os leitos de ouro e de prata, sobre um pavimento de mármore vermelho, e azul, e branco, e preto.
text_el: κἀγὼ μόνος ἐπορευόμην πλεονάκις εἰς Ιεροσόλυμα ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς καθὼς γέγραπται παντὶ τῷ Ισραηλ ἐν προστάγματι αἰωνίῳ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς καὶ τὰς δεκάτας τῶν γενημάτων καὶ τὰς πρωτοκουρίας ἔχων καὶ ἐδίδουν αὐτὰς τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον πάντων τῶν γενημάτων

text_en: so that in the third year he gave all his tithes to the proselytes , and strangers.
text_la: ita ut in tertio anno proselytis et advenis ministraret omnem decimationem.
text_pt: E dava-se de beber em copos de ouro, e os copos eram diferentes uns dos outros; e havia muito vinho real, segundo a generosidade do rei.
text_el: τὴν δεκάτην ἐδίδουν τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευι τοῖς θεραπεύουσιν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὴν δευτέραν δεκάτην ἀπεπρατιζόμην καὶ ἐπορευόμην καὶ ἐδαπάνων αὐτὰ ἐν Ιεροσολύμοις καθ' ἕκαστον ἐνιαυτόν

text_en: These and such like things did he observe when but a boy according to the law of God .
text_la: Hæc et his similia secundum legem Dei puerulus observabat.
text_pt: E o beber era por lei, sem constrangimento; porque assim tinha ordenado o rei expressamente a todos os oficiais da sua casa, que fizessem conforme a vontade de cada um.
text_el: καὶ τὴν τρίτην ἐδίδουν οἷς καθήκει καθὼς ἐνετείλατο Δεββωρα ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ πατρός μου διότι ὀρφανὸς κατελείφθην ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: But when he was a man , he took to wife Anna of his own tribe, and had a son by her, whom he called after his own name ,
text_la: Cum vero factus esset vir, accepit uxorem Annam de tribu sua, genuitque ex ea filium, nomen suum imponens ei:
text_pt: Também a rainha Vasti deu um banquete às mulheres, na casa real do rei Assuero.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἐγενόμην ἀνήρ ἔλαβον Ανναν γυναῖκα ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος τῆς πατριᾶς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐγέννησα ἐξ αὐτῆς Τωβιαν

text_en: and from his infancy he taught him to fear God , and to abstain from all sin .
text_la: quem ab infantia timere Deum docuit, et abstinere ab omni peccato.
text_pt: E ao sétimo dia, estando já o coração do rei alegre do vinho, mandou a Meumã, Bizta, Harbona, Bigtá, Abagta, Zetar e Carcas, os sete camareiros que serviam na presença do rei Assuero,
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ᾐχμαλωτίσθην εἰς Νινευη πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοί μου καὶ οἱ ἐκ τοῦ γένους μου ἤσθιον ἐκ τῶν ἄρτων τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: And when by the captivity he with his wife and his son and all his tribe had come to the city of Ninive,
text_la: Igitur, cum per captivitatem devenisset cum uxore sua et filio in civitatem Niniven cum omni tribu sua
text_pt: Que introduzissem na presença do rei a rainha Vasti, com a coroa real, para mostrar aos povos e aos príncipes a sua beleza, porque era formosa à vista.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ συνετήρησα τὴν ψυχήν μου μὴ φαγεῖν

text_en: (when all ate of the meats of the Gentiles ) he kept his soul and never was defiled with their meats.
text_la: (cum omnes ederent ex cibis gentilium), iste custodivit animam suam, et numquam contaminatus est in escis eorum.
text_pt: Porém a rainha Vasti recusou vir conforme a palavra do rei, por meio dos camareiros; assim o rei muito se enfureceu, e acendeu nele a sua ira.
text_el: καθότι ἐμεμνήμην τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ μου

text_en: And because he was mindful of the Lord with all his heart, God gave him favour in the sight of Salmanasar the king.
text_la: Et quoniam memor fuit Domini in toto corde suo, dedit illi Deus gratiam in conspectu Salmanasar regis,
text_pt: Então perguntou o rei aos sábios que entendiam dos tempos (porque assim se tratavam os negócios do rei na presença de todos os que sabiam a lei e o direito;
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ ὕψιστος χάριν καὶ μορφὴν ἐνώπιον Ενεμεσσαρου καὶ ἤμην αὐτοῦ ἀγοραστής

text_en: And he gave him leave to go wherever he would, with liberty to do whatever he had a mind.
text_la: et dedit illi potestatem quocumque vellet ire, habens libertatem quæcumque facere voluisset.
text_pt: E os mais chegados a ele eram: Carsena, Setar, Admata, Társis, Meres, Marsena, e Memucã, os sete príncipes dos persas e dos medos, que viam a face do rei, e se assentavam como principais no reino),
text_el: καὶ ἐπορευόμην εἰς τὴν Μηδίαν καὶ παρεθέμην Γαβαήλῳ τῷ ἀδελφῷ Γαβρια ἐν Ραγοις τῆς Μηδίας ἀργυρίου τάλαντα δέκα

text_en: He therefore went to all that were in captivity, and gave them wholesome admonitions.
text_la: Pergebat ergo ad omnes qui erant in captivitate, et monita salutis dabat eis.
text_pt: O que, segundo a lei, se devia fazer à rainha Vasti, por não ter obedecido ao mandado do rei Assuero, por meio dos camareiros.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἀπέθανεν Ενεμεσσαρος ἐβασίλευσεν Σενναχηριμ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ ἠκαταστάτησαν καὶ οὐκέτι ἠδυνάσθην πορευθῆναι εἰς τὴν Μηδίαν

text_en: And when he had come to Rages a city of the Medes , and had ten talents of silver of that with which he had been honoured by the king:
text_la: Cum autem venisset in Rages civitatem Medorum, et ex his quibus honoratus fuerat a rege, habuisset decem talenta argenti:
text_pt: Então disse Memucã na presença do rei e dos príncipes: Não somente contra o rei pecou a rainha Vasti, porém também contra todos os príncipes, e contra todos os povos que há em todas as províncias do rei Assuero.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ενεμεσσαρου ἐλεημοσύνας πολλὰς ἐποίουν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου

text_en: And when amongst a great multitude of his kindred, he saw Gabelus in want, who was one of his tribe, taking a note of his hand he gave him the aforesaid sum of money.
text_la: et cum in multa turba generis sui Gabelum egentem videret, qui erat ex tribu ejus, sub chirographo dedit illi memoratum pondus argenti.
text_pt: Porque a notícia do que fez a rainha chegará a todas as mulheres, de modo que aos seus olhos desprezarão a seus maridos quando ouvirem dizer: Mandou o rei Assuero que introduzissem à sua presença a rainha Vasti, porém ela não veio.
text_el: τοὺς ἄρτους μου ἐδίδουν τοῖς πεινῶσιν καὶ τὰ ἱμάτιά μου τοῖς γυμνοῖς καὶ εἴ τινα ἐκ τοῦ γένους μου ἐθεώρουν τεθνηκότα καὶ ἐρριμμένον ὀπίσω τοῦ τείχους Νινευη ἔθαπτον αὐτόν

text_en: But after a long time, Salmanasar the king being dead, when Sennacherib his son, who reigned in his place, had a hatred for the children of Israel :
text_la: Post multum vero temporis, mortuo Salmanasar rege, cum regnaret Sennacherib filius ejus pro eo, et filios Israël exosos haberet in conspectu suo,
text_pt: E neste mesmo dia as senhoras da Pérsia e da Média, ouvindo o que fez a rainha, dirão o mesmo a todos os príncipes do rei; e assim haverá muito desprezo e indignação.
text_el: καὶ εἴ τινα ἀπέκτεινεν Σενναχηριμ ὁ βασιλεύς ὅτε ἦλθεν φεύγων ἐκ τῆς Ιουδαίας ἔθαψα αὐτοὺς κλέπτων πολλοὺς γὰρ ἀπέκτεινεν ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐζητήθη ὑπὸ τοῦ βασιλέως τὰ σώματα καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη

text_en: Tobias daily went among all his kindred and comforted them, and distributed to every one as he was able, out of his goods:
text_la: Tobias quotidie pergebat per omnem cognationem suam, et consolabatur eos, dividebatque unicuique, prout poterat, de facultatibus suis:
text_pt: Se bem parecer ao rei, saia da sua parte um edito real, e escreva-se nas leis dos persas e dos medos, e não se revogue, a saber: que Vasti não entre mais na presença do rei Assuero, e o rei dê o reino dela a outra que seja melhor do que ela.
text_el: πορευθεὶς δὲ εἷς τῶν ἐν Νινευη ὑπέδειξε τῷ βασιλεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὅτι θάπτω αὐτούς καὶ ἐκρύβην ἐπιγνοὺς δὲ ὅτι ζητοῦμαι ἀποθανεῖν φοβηθεὶς ἀνεχώρησα

text_en: He fed the hungry, and gave clothes to the naked, and was careful to bury the dead, and they that were slain.
text_la: esurientes alebat, nudisque vestimenta præbebat, et mortuis atque occisis sepulturam sollicitus exhibebat.
text_pt: E, ouvindo-se o mandado, que o rei decretará em todo o seu reino (porque é grande), todas as mulheres darão honra a seus maridos, desde a maior até à menor.
text_el: καὶ διηρπάγη πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντά μου καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη μοι οὐδὲν πλὴν Αννας τῆς γυναικός μου καὶ Τωβιου τοῦ υἱοῦ μου

text_en: And when King Sennacherib had come back, fleeing from Judea by reason of the slaughter that God had made about him for his blasphemy , and being angry slew many of the children of Israel , Tobias buried their bodies.
text_la: Denique cum reversus esset rex Sennacherib, fugiens a Judæa plagam quam circa eum fecerat Deus propter blasphemiam suam, et iratus multos occideret ex filiis Israël, Tobias sepeliebat corpora eorum.
text_pt: E pareceram bem estas palavras aos olhos do rei e dos príncipes; e fez o rei conforme a palavra de Memucã.
text_el: καὶ οὐ διῆλθον ἡμέραι πεντήκοντα ἕως οὗ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτὸν οἱ δύο υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔφυγον εἰς τὰ ὄρη Αραρατ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Σαχερδονος ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔταξεν Αχιαχαρον τὸν Αναηλ υἱὸν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ μου ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἐκλογιστίαν τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν διοίκησιν

text_en: But when it was told the king, he commanded him to be slain, and took away all his substance.
text_la: At ubi nuntiatum est regi, jussit eum occidi, et tulit omnem substantiam ejus.
text_pt: Então enviou cartas a todas as províncias do rei, a cada província segundo a sua escrita, e a cada povo segundo a sua língua; que cada homem fosse senhor em sua casa, e que se falasse conforme a língua do seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἠξίωσεν Αχιαχαρος περὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Νινευη Αχιαχαρος δὲ ἦν ὁ οἰνοχόος καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ δακτυλίου καὶ διοικητὴς καὶ ἐκλογιστής καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ὁ Σαχερδονος ἐκ δευτέρας ἦν δὲ ἐξάδελφός μου

text_en: But Tobias fleeing naked away with his son and with his wife, lay concealed, for many loved him.
text_la: Tobias vero cum filio suo et cum uxore suo fugiens, nudus latuit, quia multi diligebant eum.

text_en: But after forty-five days, the king was killed by his own sons.
text_la: Post dies vero quadraginta quinque occiderunt regem filii ipsius,

text_en: And Tobias returned to his house, and all his substance was restored to him.
text_la: et reversus est Tobias in domum suam, omnisque facultas ejus restituta est ei.

text_en: But after this, when there was a festival of the Lord , and a good dinner was prepared in Tobias' house,
text_la: Post hæc vero, cum esset dies festus Domini, et factum esset prandium bonum in domo Tobiæ,
text_pt: Passadas estas coisas, e apaziguado já o furor do rei Assuero, lembrou-se de Vasti, e do que fizera, e do que se tinha decretado a seu respeito.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ κατῆλθον εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου καὶ ἀπεδόθη μοι Αννα ἡ γυνή μου καὶ Τωβιας ὁ υἱός μου ἐν τῇ πεντηκοστῇ τῇ ἑορτῇ ἥ ἐστιν ἁγία ἑπτὰ ἑβδομάδων ἐγενήθη ἄριστον καλόν μοι καὶ ἀνέπεσα τοῦ φαγεῖν

text_en: he said to his son: Go, and bring some of our tribe that fear God , to feast with us.
text_la: dixit filio suo : Vade, et adduc aliquos de tribu nostra, timentes Deum, ut epulentur nobiscum.
text_pt: Então disseram os servos do rei, que lhe serviam: Busquem-se para o rei moças virgens e formosas.
text_el: καὶ ἐθεασάμην ὄψα πολλὰ καὶ εἶπα τῷ υἱῷ μου βάδισον καὶ ἄγαγε ὃν ἐὰν εὕρῃς τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν ἐνδεῆ ὃς μέμνηται τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἰδοὺ μενῶ σε

text_en: And when he had gone, returning he told him, that one of the children of Israel lay slain in the street. And he forthwith leaped up from his place at the table, and left his dinner, and came fasting to the body.
text_la: Cumque abiisset, reversus nuntiavit ei unum ex filiis Israël jugulatum jacere in platea. Statimque exiliens de accubitu suo, relinquens prandium, jejunus pervenit ad corpus:
text_pt: E ponha o rei oficiais em todas as províncias do seu reino, que ajuntem a todas as moças virgens e formosas, na fortaleza de Susã, na casa das mulheres, aos cuidados de Hegai, camareiro do rei, guarda das mulheres, e dêem-se-lhes os seus enfeites.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν εἶπεν πάτερ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ γένους ἡμῶν ἐστραγγαλωμένος ἔρριπται ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ

text_en: And taking it up carried it privately to his house, that after the sun was down, he might bury him cautiously.
text_la: tollensque illud portavit ad domum suam occulte, ut dum sol occubuisset, caute sepeliret eum.
text_pt: E a moça que parecer bem aos olhos do rei, reine em lugar de Vasti. E isto pareceu bem aos olhos do rei, e ele assim fez.
text_el: κἀγὼ πρὶν ἢ γεύσασθαί με ἀναπηδήσας ἀνειλόμην αὐτὸν εἴς τι οἴκημα ἕως οὗ ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος

text_en: And when he had hid the body, he ate bread with mourning and fear,
text_la: Cumque occultasset corpus, manducavit panem cum luctu et tremore,
text_pt: Havia então um homem judeu na fortaleza de Susã, cujo nome era Mardoqueu, filho de Jair, filho de Simei, filho de Quis, homem benjamita,
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἐλουσάμην καὶ ἤσθιον τὸν ἄρτον μου ἐν λύπῃ

text_en: remembering the word which the Lord spoke by Amos the prophet : Your festival days shall be turned into lamentation and mourning.
text_la: memorans illum sermonem, quem dixit Dominus per Amos prophetam : Dies festi vestri convertentur in lamentationem et luctum.
text_pt: Que fora transportado de Jerusalém, com os cativos que foram levados com Jeconias, rei de Judá, o qual transportara Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθην τῆς προφητείας Αμως καθὼς εἶπεν στραφήσονται αἱ ἑορταὶ ὑμῶν εἰς πένθος καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ εὐφροσύναι ὑμῶν εἰς θρῆνον καὶ ἔκλαυσα

text_en: So when the sun was down, he went and buried him.
text_la: Cum vero sol occubuisset, abiit, et sepelivit eum.
text_pt: Este criara a Hadassa (que é Ester, filha de seu tio), porque não tinha pai nem mãe; e era jovem bela de presença e formosa; e, morrendo seu pai e sua mãe, Mardoqueu a tomara por sua filha.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος ᾠχόμην καὶ ὀρύξας ἔθαψα αὐτόν

text_en: Now all his neighbours blamed him, saying: once already commandment was given for you to be slain because of this matter, and you scarce escaped the sentence of death, and do you again bury the dead?
text_la: Arguebant autem eum omnes proximi ejus, dicentes : Jam hujus rei causa interfici jussus es, et vix effugisti mortis imperium, et iterum sepelis mortuos?
text_pt: Sucedeu que, divulgando-se o mandado do rei e a sua lei, e ajuntando-se muitas moças na fortaleza de Susã, aos cuidados de Hegai, também levaram Ester à casa do rei, sob a custódia de Hegai, guarda das mulheres.
text_el: καὶ οἱ πλησίον ἐπεγέλων λέγοντες οὐκέτι φοβεῖται φονευθῆναι περὶ τοῦ πράγματος τούτου καὶ ἀπέδρα καὶ ἰδοὺ πάλιν θάπτει τοὺς νεκρούς

text_en: But Tobias fearing God more than the king, carried off the bodies of them that were slain, and hid them in his house, and at midnight buried them.
text_la: Sed Tobias plus timens Deum quam regem, rapiebat corpora occisorum, et occultabat in domo sua, et mediis noctibus sepeliebat ea.
text_pt: E a moça pareceu formosa aos seus olhos, e alcançou graça perante ele; por isso se apressou a dar-lhe os seus enfeites, e os seus quinhões, como também em lhe dar sete moças de respeito da casa do rei; e a fez passar com as suas moças ao melhor lugar da casa das mulheres.
text_el: καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ νυκτὶ ἀνέλυσα θάψας καὶ ἐκοιμήθην μεμιαμμένος παρὰ τὸν τοῖχον τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀκάλυπτον ἦν

text_en: Now it happened one day that being wearied with burying, he came to his house, and cast himself down by the wall and slept,
text_la: Contigit autem ut quadam die fatigatus a sepultura, veniens in domum suam, jactasset se juxta parietem, et obdormisset,
text_pt: Ester, porém, não declarou o seu povo e a sua parentela, porque Mardoqueu lhe tinha ordenado que o não declarasse.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ᾔδειν ὅτι στρουθία ἐν τῷ τοίχῳ ἐστίν καὶ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου ἀνεῳγότων ἀφώδευσαν τὰ στρουθία θερμὸν εἰς τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ ἐγενήθη λευκώματα εἰς τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ ἐπορεύθην πρὸς ἰατρούς καὶ οὐκ ὠφέλησάν με Αχιαχαρος δὲ ἔτρεφέν με ἕως οὗ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Ἐλυμαΐδα

text_en: and as he was sleeping, hot dung out of a swallow's nest fell upon his eyes, and he was made blind.
text_la: et ex nido hirundinum dormienti illi calida stercora inciderent super oculos ejus, fieretque cæcus.
text_pt: E passeava Mardoqueu cada dia diante do pátio da casa das mulheres, para se informar de como Ester passava, e do que lhe sucederia.
text_el: καὶ ἡ γυνή μου Αννα ἠριθεύετο ἐν τοῖς γυναικείοις

text_en: Now this trial the Lord therefore permitted to happen to him, that an example might be given to posterity of his patience, as also of holy Job.
text_la: Hanc autem tentationem ideo permisit Dominus evenire illi, ut posteris daretur exemplum patientiæ ejus, sicut et sancti Job.
text_pt: E, chegando a vez de cada moça, para vir ao rei Assuero, depois que fora feito a ela segundo a lei das mulheres, por doze meses (porque assim se cumpriam os dias das suas purificações, seis meses com óleo de mirra, e seis meses com especiarias, e com as coisas para a purificação das mulheres),
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστελλε τοῖς κυρίοις καὶ ἀπέδωκαν αὐτῇ καὶ αὐτοὶ τὸν μισθὸν προσδόντες καὶ ἔριφον

text_en: For whereas he had always feared God from his infancy, and kept his commandments, he repined not against God because the evil of blindness had befallen him,
text_la: Nam cum ab infantia sua semper Deum timuerit, et mandata ejus custodierit, non est contristatus contra Deum quod plaga cæcitatis evenerit ei,
text_pt: Desta maneira, pois, vinha a moça ao rei; dava-se-lhe tudo quanto ela desejava, para levar consigo da casa das mulheres à casa do rei;
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἦλθεν πρός με ἤρξατο κράζειν καὶ εἶπα αὐτῇ πόθεν τὸ ἐρίφιον μὴ κλεψιμαῖόν ἐστιν ἀπόδος αὐτὸ τοῖς κυρίοις οὐ γὰρ θεμιτόν ἐστιν φαγεῖν κλεψιμαῖον

text_en: but continued immoveable in the fear of God , giving thanks to God all the days of his life.
text_la: sed immobilis in Dei timore permansit, agens gratias Deo omnibus diebus vitæ suæ.
text_pt: À tarde entrava, e pela manhã tornava à segunda casa das mulheres, sob os cuidados de Saasgaz, camareiro do rei, guarda das concubinas; não tornava mais ao rei, salvo se o rei a desejasse, e fosse chamada pelo nome.
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν δῶρον δέδοταί μοι ἐπὶ τῷ μισθῷ καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευον αὐτῇ καὶ ἔλεγον ἀποδιδόναι αὐτὸ τοῖς κυρίοις καὶ ἠρυθρίων πρὸς αὐτήν ἡ δὲ ἀποκριθεῖσα εἶπέν μοι ποῦ εἰσιν αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου καὶ αἱ δικαιοσύναι σου ἰδοὺ γνωστὰ πάντα μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: For as the kings insulted over holy Job: so his relations and kinsmen mocked at his life, saying:
text_la: Nam sicut beato Job insultabant reges, ita isti parentes et cognati ejus irridebant vitam ejus, dicentes:
text_pt: Chegando, pois, a vez de Ester, filha de Abiail, tio de Mardoqueu (que a tomara por sua filha), para ir ao rei, coisa nenhuma pediu, senão o que disse Hegai, camareiro do rei, guarda das mulheres; e alcançava Ester graça aos olhos de todos quantos a viam.

text_en: Where is your hope, for which you gave alms , and buried the dead?
text_la: Ubi est spes tua, pro qua eleemosynas et sepulturas faciebas?
text_pt: Assim foi levada Ester ao rei Assuero, à sua casa real, no décimo mês, que é o mês de tebete, no sétimo ano do seu reinado.

text_en: But Tobias rebuked them, saying: Speak not so:
text_la: Tobias vero increpabat eos, dicens : Nolite ita loqui:
text_pt: E o rei amou a Ester mais do que a todas as mulheres, e alcançou perante ele graça e benevolência mais do que todas as virgens; e pôs a coroa real na sua cabeça, e a fez rainha em lugar de Vasti.

text_en: For we are the children of saints, and look for that life which God will give to those that never change their faith from him.
text_la: quoniam filii sanctorum sumus, et vitam illam expectamus, quam Deus daturus est his qui fidem suam numquam mutant ab eo.
text_pt: Então o rei deu um grande banquete a todos os seus príncipes e aos seus servos; era o banquete de Ester; e deu alívio às províncias, e fez presentes segundo a generosidade do rei.

text_en: Now Anna his wife went daily to weaving work, and she brought home what she could get for their living by the labour of her hands.
text_la: Anna vero uxor ejus ibat ad opus textrinum quotidie, et de labore manuum suarum victum quem consequi poterat, deferebat.
text_pt: E reunindo-se segunda vez as virgens, Mardoqueu estava assentado à porta do rei.

text_en: Whereby it came to pass, that she received a young kid, and brought it home:
text_la: Unde factum est ut hædum caprarum accipiens detulisset domi:
text_pt: Ester, porém, não declarava a sua parentela e o seu povo, como Mardoqueu lhe ordenara; porque Ester cumpria o mandado de Mardoqueu, como quando a criara.

text_en: And when her husband heard it bleating, he said: Take heed, lest perhaps it be stolen: restore it to its owners, for it is not lawful for us either to eat or to touch anything that comes by theft.
text_la: cujus cum vocem balantis vir ejus audisset, dixit : Videte, ne forte furtivus sit : reddite eum dominis suis, quia non licet nobis aut edere ex furto aliquid, aut contingere.
text_pt: Naqueles dias, assentando-se Mardoqueu à porta do rei, dois camareiros do rei, dos guardas da porta, Bigtã e Teres, grandemente se indignaram, e procuraram atentar contra o rei Assuero.

text_en: At these words his wife being angry answered: It is evident the hope has come to nothing, and your alms now appear.
text_la: Ad hæc uxor ejus irata respondit : Manifeste vana facta est spes tua, et eleemosynæ tuæ modo apparuerunt.
text_pt: E veio isto ao conhecimento de Mardoqueu, e ele o fez saber à rainha Ester; e Ester o disse ao rei, em nome de Mardoqueu.

text_en: And with these and other, such like words she upbraided him.
text_la: Atque his et aliis hujuscemodi verbis exprobrabat ei.
text_pt: E inquiriu-se o negócio, e se descobriu, e ambos foram pendurados numa forca; e foi escrito nas crônicas perante o rei.

text_en: Then Tobias sighed, and began to pray with tears,
text_la: Tunc Tobias ingemuit, et cœpit orare cum lacrimis,
text_pt: Depois destas coisas o rei Assuero engrandeceu a Hamã, filho de Hamedata, agagita, e o exaltou, e pôs o seu assento acima de todos os príncipes que estavam com ele.
text_el: καὶ λυπηθεὶς ἔκλαυσα καὶ προσευξάμην μετ' ὀδύνης λέγων

text_en: saying, You are just , O Lord , and all your judgments are just , and all your ways mercy, and truth , and judgment:
text_la: dicens : Justus es, Domine, et omnia judicia tua justa sunt, et omnes viæ tuæ, misericordia, et veritas, et judicium.
text_pt: E todos os servos do rei, que estavam à porta do rei, se inclinavam e se prostravam perante Hamã; porque assim tinha ordenado o rei acerca dele; porém Mardoqueu não se inclinava nem se prostrava.
text_el: δίκαιος εἶ κύριε καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοί σου ἐλεημοσύναι καὶ ἀλήθεια καὶ κρίσιν ἀληθινὴν καὶ δικαίαν σὺ κρίνεις εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And now, O Lord , think of me, and take not revenge of my sins , neither remember my offences, nor those of my parents.
text_la: Et nunc Domine, memor esto mei, et ne vindictam sumas de peccatis meis, neque reminiscaris delicta mea, vel parentum meorum.
text_pt: Então os servos do rei, que estavam à porta do rei, disseram a Mardoqueu: Por que transgrides o mandado do rei?
text_el: μνήσθητί μου καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ' ἐμέ μή με ἐκδικήσῃς ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις μου καὶ τοῖς ἀγνοήμασίν μου καὶ τῶν πατέρων μου ἃ ἥμαρτον ἐνώπιόν σου

text_en: For we have not obeyed your commandments, therefore are we delivered to spoil and to captivity, and death, and are made a fable, and a reproach to all nations, amongst which you have scattered us.
text_la: Quoniam non obedivimus præceptis tuis, ideo traditi sumus in direptionem, et captivitatem, et mortem, et in fabulam, et in improperium omnibus nationibus in quibus dispersisti nos.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, dizendo-lhe eles isto, dia após dia, e não lhes dando ele ouvidos, o fizeram saber a Hamã, para verem se as palavras de Mardoqueu se sustentariam, porque ele lhes tinha declarado que era judeu.
text_el: παρήκουσαν γὰρ τῶν ἐντολῶν σου ἔδωκας ἡμᾶς εἰς διαρπαγὴν καὶ αἰχμαλωσίαν καὶ θάνατον καὶ παραβολὴν ὀνειδισμοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐν οἷς ἐσκορπίσμεθα

text_en: And now, O Lord , great are your judgments, because we have not done according to your precepts, and have not walked sincerely before you.
text_la: Et nunc Domine, magna judicia tua, quia non egimus secundum præcepta tua, et non ambulavimus sinceriter coram te.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, Hamã que Mardoqueu não se inclinava nem se prostrava diante dele, Hamã se encheu de furor.
text_el: καὶ νῦν πολλαὶ αἱ κρίσεις σού εἰσιν ἀληθιναὶ ἐξ ἐμοῦ ποιῆσαι περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου καὶ τῶν πατέρων μου ὅτι οὐκ ἐποιήσαμεν τὰς ἐντολάς σου οὐ γὰρ ἐπορεύθημεν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ ἐνώπιόν σου

text_en: And now, O Lord , do with me according to your will, and command my spirit to be received in peace: for it is better for me to die, than to live.
text_la: Et nunc Domine, secundum voluntatem tuam fac mecum, et præcipe in pace recipi spiritum meum : expedit enim mihi mori magis quam vivere.
text_pt: Porém teve como pouco, nos seus propósitos, o pôr as mãos só em Mardoqueu (porque lhe haviam declarado de que povo era Mardoqueu); Hamã, pois, procurou destruir a todos os judeus, o povo de Mardoqueu, que havia em todo o reino de Assuero.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κατὰ τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐνώπιόν σου ποίησον μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐπίταξον ἀναλαβεῖν τὸ πνεῦμά μου ὅπως ἀπολυθῶ καὶ γένωμαι γῆ διότι λυσιτελεῖ μοι ἀποθανεῖν ἢ ζῆν ὅτι ὀνειδισμοὺς ψευδεῖς ἤκουσα καὶ λύπη ἐστὶν πολλὴ ἐν ἐμοί ἐπίταξον ἀπολυθῆναί με τῆς ἀνάγκης ἤδη εἰς τὸν αἰώνιον τόπον μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Now it happened on the same day, that Sara daughter of Raguel, in Rages a city of the Medes , received a reproach from one of her father's servant maids,
text_la: Eadem itaque die, contigit ut Sara filia Raguelis in Rages civitate Medorum et ipsa audiret improperium ab una ex ancillis patris sui,
text_pt: No primeiro mês (que é o mês de Nisã), no ano duodécimo do rei Assuero, se lançou Pur, isto é, a sorte, perante Hamã, para cada dia, e para cada mês, até ao duodécimo mês, que é o mês de Adar.
text_el: ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ ἡμέρᾳ συνέβη τῇ θυγατρὶ Ραγουηλ Σαρρα ἐν Ἐκβατάνοις τῆς Μηδίας καὶ ταύτην ὀνειδισθῆναι ὑπὸ παιδισκῶν πατρὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: because she had been given to seven husbands and a devil named Asmodeus had killed them, at their first going in unto her.
text_la: quoniam tradita fuerat septem viris, et dæmonium nomine Asmodæus occiderat eos, mox ut ingressi fuissent ad eam.
text_pt: E Hamã disse ao rei Assuero: Existe espalhado e dividido entre os povos em todas as províncias do teu reino um povo, cujas leis são diferentes das leis de todos os povos, e que não cumpre as leis do rei; por isso não convém ao rei deixá-lo ficar.
text_el: ὅτι ἦν δεδομένη ἀνδράσιν ἑπτά καὶ Ασμοδαυς τὸ πονηρὸν δαιμόνιον ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτοὺς πρὶν ἢ γενέσθαι αὐτοὺς μετ' αὐτῆς ὡς ἐν γυναιξίν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῇ οὐ συνίεις ἀποπνίγουσά σου τοὺς ἄνδρας ἤδη ἑπτὰ ἔσχες καὶ ἑνὸς αὐτῶν οὐκ ὠνάσθης

text_en: So when she reproved the maid for her fault, she answered her, saying: May we never see son, or daughter of you upon the earth, you murderer of your husbands.
text_la: Ergo cum pro culpa sua increparet puellam, respondit ei, dicens : Amplius ex te non videamus filium aut filiam super terram, interfectrix virorum tuorum.
text_pt: Se bem parecer ao rei, decrete-se que os matem; e eu porei nas mãos dos que fizerem a obra dez mil talentos de prata, para que entrem nos tesouros do rei.
text_el: τί ἡμᾶς μαστιγοῖς εἰ ἀπέθαναν βάδιζε μετ' αὐτῶν μὴ ἴδοιμέν σου υἱὸν ἢ θυγατέρα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: Will you kill me also, as you have already killed seven husbands? At these words, she went into an upper chamber of her house: and for three days and three nights did neither eat nor drink:
text_la: Numquid et occidere me vis, sicut jam occidisti septem viros? Ad hanc vocem perrexit in superius cubiculum domus suæ : et tribus diebus, et tribus noctibus non manducavit, neque bibit:
text_pt: Então tirou o rei o anel da sua mão, e o deu a Hamã, filho de Hamedata, agagita, adversário dos judeus.
text_el: ταῦτα ἀκούσασα ἐλυπήθη σφόδρα ὥστε ἀπάγξασθαι καὶ εἶπεν μία μέν εἰμι τῷ πατρί μου ἐὰν ποιήσω τοῦτο ὄνειδος αὐτῷ ἐστιν καὶ τὸ γῆρας αὐτοῦ κατάξω μετ' ὀδύνης εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: But continuing in prayer with tears besought God , that he would deliver her from this reproach.
text_la: sed in oratione persistens cum lacrimis deprecabatur Deum, ut ab isto improperio liberaret eam.
text_pt: E disse o rei a Hamã: Essa prata te é dada como também esse povo, para fazeres dele o que bem parecer aos teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐδεήθη πρὸς τῇ θυρίδι καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογητὸς εἶ κύριε ὁ θεός μου καὶ εὐλογητὸν τὸ ὄνομά σου τὸ ἅγιον καὶ ἔντιμον εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας εὐλογήσαισάν σε πάντα τὰ ἔργα σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And it came to pass on the third day when she was making an end of her prayer , blessing the Lord ,
text_la: Factum est autem die tertia, dum compleret orationem, benedicens Dominum
text_pt: Então chamaram os escrivães do rei no primeiro mês, no dia treze do mesmo e, conforme a tudo quanto Hamã mandou, se escreveu aos príncipes do rei, e aos governadores que havia sobre cada província, e aos líderes, de cada povo; a cada província segundo a sua escrita, e a cada povo segundo a sua língua; em nome do rei Assuero se escreveu, e com o anel do rei se selou.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου καὶ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου εἰς σὲ δέδωκα

text_en: she said: Blessed is your name , O God of our fathers, who when you have been angry , will show mercy, and in the time of tribulation forgive the sins of them that call upon you.
text_la: dixit : Benedictum est nomen tuum, Deus patrum nostrorum : qui cum iratus fueris, misericordiam facies, et in tempore tribulationis peccata dimittis his qui invocant te.
text_pt: E enviaram-se as cartas por intermédio dos correios a todas as províncias do rei, para que destruíssem, matassem, e fizessem perecer a todos os judeus, desde o jovem até ao velho, crianças e mulheres, em um mesmo dia, a treze do duodécimo mês (que é o mês de Adar), e que saqueassem os seus bens.
text_el: εἰπὸν ἀπολῦσαί με ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ μὴ ἀκοῦσαί με μηκέτι ὀνειδισμόν

text_en: To you, O Lord , I turn my face, to you I direct my eyes.
text_la: Ad te, Domine, faciem meam converto; ad te oculos meos dirigo.
text_pt: Uma cópia do despacho que determinou a divulgação da lei em cada província, foi enviada a todos os povos, para que estivessem preparados para aquele dia.
text_el: σὺ γινώσκεις κύριε ὅτι καθαρά εἰμι ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας ἀνδρὸς

text_en: I beg, O Lord , that you loose me from the bond of this reproach, or else take me away from the earth.
text_la: Peto, Domine, ut de vinculo improperii hujus absolvas me, aut certe desuper terram eripias me.
text_pt: Os correios, pois, impelidos pela palavra do rei, saíram, e a lei se proclamou na fortaleza de Susã. E o rei e Hamã se assentaram a beber, porém a cidade de Susã estava confusa.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐμόλυνα τὸ ὄνομά μου οὐδὲ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρός μου ἐν τῇ γῇ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας μου μονογενής εἰμι τῷ πατρί μου καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρχει αὐτῷ παιδίον ὃ κληρονομήσει αὐτόν οὐδὲ ἀδελφὸς ἐγγὺς οὐδὲ ὑπάρχων αὐτῷ υἱός ἵνα συντηρήσω ἐμαυτὴν αὐτῷ γυναῖκα ἤδη ἀπώλοντό μοι ἑπτά ἵνα τί μοι ζῆν καὶ εἰ μὴ δοκεῖ σοι ἀποκτεῖναί με ἐπίταξον ἐπιβλέψαι ἐπ' ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλεῆσαί με καὶ μηκέτι ἀκοῦσαί με ὀνειδισμόν

text_en: You know, O Lord , that I never coveted a husband, and have kept my soul clean from all lust .
text_la: Tu scis, Domine, quia numquam concupivi virum, et mundam servavi animam meam ab omni concupiscentia.
text_el: καὶ εἰσηκούσθη ἡ προσευχὴ ἀμφοτέρων ἐνώπιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ μεγάλου Ραφαηλ

text_en: Never have I joined myself with them that play: neither have I made myself partaker with them that walk in lightness.
text_la: Numquam cum ludentibus miscui me, neque cum his qui in levitate ambulant, participem me præbui.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστάλη ἰάσασθαι τοὺς δύο τοῦ Τωβιτ λεπίσαι τὰ λευκώματα καὶ Σαρραν τὴν τοῦ Ραγουηλ δοῦναι Τωβια τῷ υἱῷ Τωβιτ γυναῖκα καὶ δῆσαι Ασμοδαυν τὸ πονηρὸν δαιμόνιον διότι Τωβια ἐπιβάλλει κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ καιρῷ ἐπιστρέψας Τωβιτ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ Σαρρα ἡ τοῦ Ραγουηλ κατέβη ἐκ τοῦ ὑπερῴου αὐτῆς

text_en: But a husband I consented to take, with your fear, not with my lust .
text_la: Virum autem cum timore tuo, non cum libidine mea, consensi suscipere.

text_en: And either I was unworthy of them, or they perhaps were not worthy of me: because perhaps you have kept me for another man ,
text_la: Et, aut ego indigna fui illis, aut illi forsitan me non fuerunt digni, quia forsitan viro alii conservasti me.

text_en: for your counsel is not in man's power.
text_la: Non est enim in hominis potestate consilium tuum.

text_en: But this every one is sure of that worships you, that his life, if it be under trial, shall be crowned and if it be under tribulation, it shall be delivered: and if it be under correction, it shall be allowed to come to your mercy.
text_la: Hoc autem pro certo habet omnis qui te colit : quod vita ejus, si in probatione fuerit, coronabitur; si autem in tribulatione fuerit, liberabitur; et si in correptione fuerit, ad misericordiam tuam venire licebit.

text_en: For you are not delighted in our being lost, because after a storm you make a calm, and after tears and weeping you pour in joyfulness.
text_la: Non enim delectaris in perditionibus nostris : quia post tempestatem tranquillum facis, et post lacrimationem et fletum, exultationem infundis.

text_en: Be your name , O God of Israel , blessed for ever,
text_la: Sit nomen tuum, Deus Israël, benedictum in sæcula.

text_en: at that time the prayers of them both were heard in the sight of the glory of the most high God :
text_la: In illo tempore exauditæ sunt preces amborum in conspectu gloriæ summi Dei:

text_en: And the holy angel of the Lord , Raphael was sent to heal them both, whose prayers at one time were rehearsed in the sight of the Lord .
text_la: et missus est angelus Domini sanctus Raphaël ut curaret eos ambos, quorum uno tempore sunt orationes in conspectu Domini recitatæ.

text_en: Therefore when Tobias thought that his prayer was heard that he might die, he called to him Tobias his son,
text_la: Igitur cum Tobias putaret orationem suam exaudiri ut mori potuisset, vocavit ad se Tobiam filium suum,
text_pt: Quando Mardoqueu soube tudo quanto se havia passado, rasgou as suas vestes, e vestiu-se de saco e de cinza, e saiu pelo meio da cidade, e clamou com grande e amargo clamor;
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐμνήσθη Τωβιτ περὶ τοῦ ἀργυρίου οὗ παρέθετο Γαβαηλ ἐν Ῥάγοις τῆς Μηδίας

text_en: and said to him: Hear, my son, the words of my mouth, and lay them as a foundation in your heart.
text_la: dixitque ei : Audi, fili mi, verba oris mei, et ea in corde tuo quasi fundamentum construe.
text_pt: E chegou até diante da porta do rei, porque ninguém vestido de saco podia entrar pelas portas do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐν ἑαυτῷ ἐγὼ ᾐτησάμην θάνατον τί οὐ καλῶ Τωβιαν τὸν υἱόν μου ἵνα αὐτῷ ὑποδείξω πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν με

text_en: When God shall take my soul , you shall bury my body: and you shall honour your mother all the days of her life:
text_la: Cum acceperit Deus animam meam, corpus meum sepeli : et honorem habebis matri tuæ omnibus diebus vitæ ejus:
text_pt: E em todas as províncias aonde a palavra do rei e a sua lei chegava, havia entre os judeus grande luto, com jejum, e choro, e lamentação; e muitos estavam deitados em saco e em cinza.
text_el: καὶ καλέσας αὐτὸν εἶπεν παιδίον ἐὰν ἀποθάνω θάψον με καὶ μὴ ὑπερίδῃς τὴν μητέρα σου τίμα αὐτὴν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου καὶ ποίει τὸ ἀρεστὸν αὐτῇ καὶ μὴ λυπήσῃς αὐτήν

text_en: For you must be mindful what and how great perils she suffered for you in her womb.
text_la: memor enim esse debes, quæ et quanta pericula passa sit propter te in utero suo.
text_pt: Então vieram as servas de Ester, e os seus camareiros, e fizeram-na saber, do que a rainha muito se doeu; e mandou roupas para vestir a Mardoqueu, e tirar-lhe o pano de saco; porém ele não as aceitou.
text_el: μνήσθητι παιδίον ὅτι πολλοὺς κινδύνους ἑόρακεν ἐπὶ σοὶ ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ ὅταν ἀποθάνῃ θάψον αὐτὴν παρ' ἐμοὶ ἐν ἑνὶ τάφῳ

text_en: And when she also shall have ended the time of her life, bury her by me.
text_la: Cum autem et ipsa compleverit tempus vitæ suæ, sepelias eam circa me.
text_pt: Então Ester chamou a Hatá (um dos camareiros do rei, que este tinha posto para servi-la), e deu-lhe ordem para ir a Mardoqueu, para saber que era aquilo, e porquê.
text_el: πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας παιδίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν μνημόνευε καὶ μὴ θελήσῃς ἁμαρτάνειν καὶ παραβῆναι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ δικαιοσύνην ποίει πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου καὶ μὴ πορευθῇς ταῖς ὁδοῖς τῆς ἀδικίας

text_en: And all the days of your life have God in your mind: and take heed that you never consent to sin , nor transgress the commandments of the Lord our God .
text_la: Omnibus autem diebus vitæ tuæ in mente habeto Deum : et cave ne aliquando peccato consentias, et prætermittas præcepta Domini Dei nostri.
text_pt: E, saindo Hatá a Mardoqueu, à praça da cidade, que estava diante da porta do rei,
text_el: διότι ποιοῦντός σου τὴν ἀλήθειαν εὐοδίαι ἔσονται ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις σου

text_en: Give alms out of your substance, and turn not away your face from any poor person: for so it shall come to pass that the face of the Lord shall not be turned from you.
text_la: Ex substantia tua fac eleemosynam, et noli avertere faciem tuam ab ullo paupere : ita enim fiet ut nec a te avertatur facies Domini.
text_pt: Mardoqueu lhe fez saber tudo quanto lhe tinha sucedido; como também a soma exata do dinheiro, que Hamã dissera que daria para os tesouros do rei, pelos judeus, para destruí-los.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ποιοῦσι τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐκ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων σοι ποίει ἐλεημοσύνην καὶ μὴ φθονεσάτω σου ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς ἐν τῷ ποιεῖν σε ἐλεημοσύνην μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπὸ παντὸς πτωχοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ σοῦ οὐ μὴ ἀποστραφῇ τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: According to your ability be merciful.
text_la: Quomodo potueris, ita esto misericors.
text_pt: Também lhe deu a cópia da lei escrita, que se publicara em Susã, para os destruir, para que a mostrasse a Ester, e a fizesse saber; e para lhe ordenar que fosse ter com o rei, e lhe pedisse e suplicasse na sua presença pelo seu povo.
text_el: ὡς σοὶ ὑπάρχει κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος ποίησον ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐλεημοσύνην ἐὰν ὀλίγον σοι ὑπάρχῃ κατὰ τὸ ὀλίγον μὴ φοβοῦ ποιεῖν ἐλεημοσύνην

text_en: If you have much give abundantly: if you have little, take care even so to bestow willingly a little.
text_la: Si multum tibi fuerit, abundanter tribue : si exiguum tibi fuerit, etiam exiguum libenter impertiri stude.
text_pt: Veio, pois, Hatá, e fez saber a Ester as palavras de Mardoqueu.
text_el: θέμα γὰρ ἀγαθὸν θησαυρίζεις σεαυτῷ εἰς ἡμέραν ἀνάγκης

text_en: For thus you store up to yourself a good reward for the day of necessity.
text_la: Præmium enim bonum tibi thesaurizas in die necessitatis:
text_pt: Então falou Ester a Hatá, mandando-o dizer a Mardoqueu:
text_el: διότι ἐλεημοσύνη ἐκ θανάτου ῥύεται καὶ οὐκ ἐᾷ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸ σκότος

text_en: For alms deliver from all sin , and from death, and will not suffer the soul to go into darkness.
text_la: quoniam eleemosyna ab omni peccato et a morte liberat, et non patietur animam ire in tenebras.
text_pt: Todos os servos do rei, e o povo das províncias do rei, bem sabem que todo o homem ou mulher que chegar ao rei no pátio interior, sem ser chamado, não há senão uma sentença, a de morte, salvo se o rei estender para ele o cetro de ouro, para que viva; e eu nestes trinta dias não tenho sido chamada para ir ao rei.
text_el: δῶρον γὰρ ἀγαθόν ἐστιν ἐλεημοσύνη πᾶσι τοῖς ποιοῦσιν αὐτὴν ἐνώπιον τοῦ ὑψίστου

text_en: Alms shall be a great confidence before the most high God , to all them that give it.
text_la: Fiducia magna erit coram summo Deo, eleemosyna omnibus facientibus eam.
text_pt: E fizeram saber a Mardoqueu as palavras de Ester.
text_el: πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ παιδίον ἀπὸ πάσης πορνείας καὶ γυναῖκα πρῶτον λαβὲ ἀπὸ τοῦ σπέρματος τῶν πατέρων σου μὴ λάβῃς γυναῖκα ἀλλοτρίαν ἣ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς τοῦ πατρός σου διότι υἱοὶ προφητῶν ἐσμεν Νωε Αβρααμ Ισαακ Ιακωβ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος μνήσθητι παιδίον ὅτι οὗτοι πάντες ἔλαβον γυναῖκας ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν καὶ εὐλογήθησαν ἐν τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν κληρονομήσει γῆν

text_en: Take heed to keep yourself, my son, from all fornication, and beside your wife never endure to know a crime.
text_la: Attende tibi, fili mi, ab omni fornicatione, et præter uxorem tuam numquam patiaris crimen scire.
text_pt: Então Mardoqueu mandou que respondessem a Ester: Não imagines no teu íntimo que, por estares na casa do rei, escaparás só tu entre todos os judeus.
text_el: καὶ νῦν παιδίον ἀγάπα τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου καὶ μὴ ὑπερηφανεύου τῇ καρδίᾳ σου ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου καὶ τῶν υἱῶν καὶ θυγατέρων τοῦ λαοῦ σου λαβεῖν σεαυτῷ ἐξ αὐτῶν γυναῖκα διότι ἐν τῇ ὑπερηφανίᾳ ἀπώλεια καὶ ἀκαταστασία πολλή καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀχρειότητι ἐλάττωσις καὶ ἔνδεια μεγάλη ἡ γὰρ ἀχρειότης μήτηρ ἐστὶν τοῦ λιμοῦ

text_en: Never suffer pride to reign in your mind, or in your words: for from it all perdition took its beginning.
text_la: Superbiam numquam in tuo sensu aut in tuo verbo dominari permittas: in ipsa enim initium sumpsit omnis perditio.
text_pt: Porque, se de todo te calares neste tempo, socorro e livramento de outra parte sairá para os judeus, mas tu e a casa de teu pai perecereis; e quem sabe se para tal tempo como este chegaste a este reino?
text_el: μισθὸς παντὸς ἀνθρώπου ὃς ἐὰν ἐργάσηται παρὰ σοὶ μὴ αὐλισθήτω ἀλλὰ ἀπόδος αὐτῷ παραυτίκα καὶ ἐὰν δουλεύσῃς τῷ θεῷ ἀποδοθήσεταί σοι πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ παιδίον ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις σου καὶ ἴσθι πεπαιδευμένος ἐν πάσῃ ἀναστροφῇ σου

text_en: If any man has done any work for you, immediately pay him his hire, and let not the wages of your hired servant stay with you at all.
text_la: Quicumque tibi aliquid operatus fuerit, statim ei mercedem restitue, et merces mercenarii tui apud te omnino non remaneat.
text_pt: Então disse Ester que tornassem a dizer a Mardoqueu:
text_el: καὶ ὃ μισεῖς μηδενὶ ποιήσῃς οἶνον εἰς μέθην μὴ πίῃς καὶ μὴ πορευθήτω μετὰ σοῦ μέθη ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ σου

text_en: See that you never do to another what you would hate to have done to you by another.
text_la: Quod ab alio oderis fieri tibi, vide ne tu aliquando alteri facias.
text_pt: Vai, ajunta a todos os judeus que se acharem em Susã, e jejuai por mim, e não comais nem bebais por três dias, nem de dia nem de noite, e eu e as minhas servas também assim jejuaremos. E assim irei ter com o rei, ainda que não seja segundo a lei; e se perecer, pereci.
text_el: ἐκ τοῦ ἄρτου σου δίδου πεινῶντι καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἱματίων σου τοῖς γυμνοῖς πᾶν ὃ ἐὰν περισσεύσῃ σοι ποίει ἐλεημοσύνην καὶ μὴ φθονεσάτω σου ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς ἐν τῷ ποιεῖν σε ἐλεημοσύνην

text_en: Eat your bread with the hungry and the needy, and with your garments cover the naked,
text_la: Panem tuum cum esurientibus et egenis comede, et de vestimentis tuis nudos tege.
text_pt: Então Mardoqueu foi, e fez conforme a tudo quanto Ester lhe ordenou.
text_el: ἔκχεον τοὺς ἄρτους σου ἐπὶ τὸν τάφον τῶν δικαίων καὶ μὴ δῷς τοῖς ἁμαρτωλοῖς

text_en: lay out your bread, and your wine upon the burial of a just man , and do not eat and drink thereof with the wicked.
text_la: Panem tuum et vinum tuum super sepulturam justi constitue, et noli ex eo manducare et bibere cum peccatoribus.
text_el: συμβουλίαν παρὰ παντὸς φρονίμου ζήτησον καὶ μὴ καταφρονήσῃς ἐπὶ πάσης συμβουλίας χρησίμης

text_en: Seek counsel always of a wise man .
text_la: Consilium semper a sapiente perquire.
text_el: καὶ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ εὐλόγει κύριον τὸν θεὸν καὶ παρ' αὐτοῦ αἴτησον ὅπως αἱ ὁδοί σου εὐθεῖαι γένωνται καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ τρίβοι καὶ βουλαὶ εὐοδωθῶσιν διότι πᾶν ἔθνος οὐκ ἔχει βουλήν ἀλλὰ αὐτὸς ὁ κύριος δίδωσιν πάντα τὰ ἀγαθὰ καὶ ὃν ἐὰν θέλῃ ταπεινοῖ καθὼς βούλεται καὶ νῦν παιδίον μνημόνευε τῶν ἐντολῶν μου καὶ μὴ ἐξαλειφθήτωσαν ἐκ τῆς καρδίας σου

text_en: Bless God at all times: and desire of him to direct your ways, and that all your counsels may abide in him.
text_la: Omni tempore benedic Deum : et pete ab eo ut vias tuas dirigat, et omnia consilia tua in ipso permaneant.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὑποδεικνύω σοι τὰ δέκα τάλαντα τοῦ ἀργυρίου ἃ παρεθέμην Γαβαήλῳ τῷ τοῦ Γαβρια ἐν Ῥάγοις τῆς Μηδίας

text_en: I tell you also, my son, that I lent ten talents of silver, while you were yet a child, to Gabelus, in Rages a city of the Medes , and I have a note of his hand with me:
text_la: Indico etiam tibi, fili mi, dedisse me decem talenta argenti, dum adhuc infantulus esses, Gabelo, in Rages civitate Medorum, et chirographum ejus apud me habeo:
text_el: καὶ μὴ φοβοῦ παιδίον ὅτι ἐπτωχεύσαμεν ὑπάρχει σοι πολλά ἐὰν φοβηθῇς τὸν θεὸν καὶ ἀποστῇς ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας καὶ ποιήσῃς τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now therefore inquire how you may go to him, and receive of him the foresaid sum of money, and restore to him the note of his hand.
text_la: et ideo perquire quomodo ad eum pervenias, et recipias ab eo supra memoratum pondus argenti, et restituas ei chirographum suum.

text_en: Fear not, my son: we lead indeed a poor life, but we shall have many good things if we fear God , and depart from all sin , and do that which is good .
text_la: Noli timere, fili mi : pauperem quidem vitam gerimus, sed multa bona habebimus si timuerimus Deum, et recesserimus ab omni peccato, et fecerimus bene.

text_en: Then Tobias answered his father, and said: I will do all things, father, which you have commanded me.
text_la: Tunc respondit Tobias patri suo, et dixit : Omnia quæcumque præcepisti mihi faciam, pater.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que ao terceiro dia Ester se vestiu com trajes reais, e se pôs no pátio interior da casa do rei, defronte do aposento do rei; e o rei estava assentado sobre o seu trono real, na casa real, defronte da porta do aposento.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς Τωβιας εἶπεν αὐτῷ πάτερ ποιήσω πάντα ὅσα ἐντέταλσαί μοι

text_en: But how I shall get this money, I cannot tell; he knows not me, and I know not him: what token shall I give him? nor did I ever know the way which leads thither.
text_la: Quomodo autem pecuniam hanc requiram, ignoro : ille me nescit, et ego eum ignoro : quod signum dabo ei? sed neque viam per quam pergatur illuc aliquando cognovi.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, vendo o rei a rainha Ester, que estava no pátio, ela alcançou graça aos seus olhos; e o rei estendeu para Ester o cetro de ouro, que tinha na sua mão, e Ester chegou, e tocou a ponta do cetro.
text_el: ἀλλὰ πῶς δυνήσομαι λαβεῖν τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ οὐ γινώσκω αὐτόν

text_en: Then his father answered him, and said: I have a note of his hand with me, which when you shall show him, he will presently pay it.
text_la: Tunc pater suus respondit illi, et dixit : Chirographum quidem illius penes me habeo : quod dum illi ostenderis, statim restituet.
text_pt: Então o rei lhe disse: Que é que queres, rainha Ester, ou qual é a tua petição? Até metade do reino se te dará.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὸ χειρόγραφον καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ζήτησον σεαυτῷ ἄνθρωπον ὃς συμπορεύσεταί σοι καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ μισθόν ἕως ζῶ καὶ λαβὲ πορευθεὶς τὸ ἀργύριον

text_en: But go now, and seek you out some faithful man , to go with you for his hire: that you may receive it, while I yet live.
text_la: Sed perge nunc, et inquire tibi aliquem fidelem virum, qui eat tecum salva mercede sua, ut dum adhuc vivo, recipias eam.
text_pt: E disse Ester: Se parecer bem ao rei, venha hoje com Hamã ao banquete que lhe tenho preparado.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ζητῆσαι ἄνθρωπον καὶ εὗρεν τὸν Ραφαηλ ὃς ἦν ἄγγελος καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει

text_en: Then Tobias going forth, found a beautiful young man, standing girded, and as it were ready to walk.
text_la: Tunc egressus Tobias, invenit juvenem splendidum stantem præcinctum, et quasi paratum ad ambulandum.
text_pt: Então disse o rei: Fazei apressar a Hamã, para que se atenda ao desejo de Ester. Vindo, pois, o rei e Hamã ao banquete, que Ester tinha preparado,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εἰ δύναμαι πορευθῆναι μετὰ σοῦ ἐν Ῥάγοις τῆς Μηδίας καὶ εἰ ἔμπειρος εἶ τῶν τόπων

text_en: And not knowing that he was an angel of God , he saluted him, and said: From whence are you, good young man?
text_la: Et ignorans quod angelus Dei esset, salutavit eum, et dixit : Unde te habemus, bone juvenis?
text_pt: Disse o rei a Ester, no banquete do vinho: Qual é a tua petição? E ser-te-á concedida, e qual é o teu desejo? E se fará, ainda até metade do reino.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος πορεύσομαι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἐμπειρῶ καὶ παρὰ Γαβαηλ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν ηὐλίσθην

text_en: But he answered: Of the children of Israel . And Tobias said to him: Do you know the way that leads to the country of the Medes ?
text_la: At ille respondit : Ex filiis Israël. Et Tobias dixit ei : Nosti viam quæ ducit in regionem Medorum?
text_pt: Então respondeu Ester, e disse: Minha petição e desejo é:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τωβιας ὑπόμεινόν με καὶ ἐρῶ τῷ πατρί μου

text_en: And he answered: I know it: and I have often walked through all the ways thereof, and I have abode with Gabelus our brother, who dwells at Rages a city of the Medes , which is situate in the mount of Ecbatana.
text_la: Cui respondit : Novi : et omnia itinera ejus frequenter ambulavi, et mansi apud Gabelum fratrem nostrum, qui moratur in Rages civitate Medorum, quæ posita est in monte Ecbatanis.
text_pt: Se achei graça aos olhos do rei, e se bem parecer ao rei conceder-me a minha petição, e cumprir o meu desejo, venha o rei com Hamã ao banquete que lhes hei de preparar, e amanhã farei conforme a palavra do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ πορεύου καὶ μὴ χρονίσῃς

text_en: And Tobias said to him: Stay for me, I beseech you, till I tell these same things to my father.
text_la: Cui Tobias ait : Sustine me obsecro, donec hæc ipsa nuntiem patri meo.
text_pt: Então saiu Hamã naquele dia alegre e de bom ânimo; porém, vendo Mardoqueu à porta do rei, e que ele não se levantara nem se movera diante dele, então Hamã se encheu de furor contra Mardoqueu.
text_el: καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἶπεν τῷ πατρί ἰδοὺ εὕρηκα ὃς συμπορεύσεταί μοι ὁ δὲ εἶπεν φώνησον αὐτὸν πρός με ἵνα ἐπιγνῶ ποίας φυλῆς ἐστιν καὶ εἰ πιστὸς τοῦ πορευθῆναι μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: Then Tobias going in told all these things to his father. Upon which his father being in admiration, desired that he would come in unto him.
text_la: Tunc ingressus Tobias, indicavit universa hæc patri suo. Super quæ admiratus pater, rogavit ut introiret ad eum.
text_pt: Hamã, porém, se refreou, e foi para sua casa; e enviou, e mandou vir os seus amigos, e Zeres, sua mulher.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτόν καὶ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ ἠσπάσαντο ἀλλήλους

text_en: So going in he saluted him, and said: Joy be to you always.
text_la: Ingressus itaque salutavit eum, et dixit : Gaudium tibi sit semper.
text_pt: E contou-lhes Hamã a glória das suas riquezas, a multidão de seus filhos, e tudo em que o rei o tinha engrandecido, e como o tinha exaltado sobre os príncipes e servos do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τωβιτ ἄδελφε ἐκ ποίας φυλῆς καὶ ἐκ ποίας πατρίδος σὺ εἶ ὑπόδειξόν μοι

text_en: And Tobias said: What manner of joy shall be to me, who sit in darkness and see not the light of heaven ?
text_la: Et ait Tobias : Quale gaudium mihi erit, qui in tenebris sedeo, et lumen cæli non video?
text_pt: Disse mais Hamã: Tampouco a rainha Ester a ninguém fez vir com o rei ao banquete que tinha preparado, senão a mim; e também para amanhã estou convidado por ela juntamente com o rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ φυλὴν καὶ πατριὰν σὺ ζητεῖς ἢ μίσθιον ὃς συμπορεύσεται μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ σου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τωβιτ βούλομαι ἄδελφε ἐπιγνῶναι τὸ γένος σου καὶ τὸ ὄνομα

text_en: And the young man said to him: Be of good courage , your cure from God is at hand.
text_la: Cui ait juvenis : Forti animo esto : in proximo est ut a Deo cureris.
text_pt: Porém tudo isto não me satisfaz, enquanto eu vir o judeu Mardoqueu assentado à porta do rei.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἐγὼ Αζαριας Ανανιου τοῦ μεγάλου τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου

text_en: And Tobias said to him: Can you conduct my son to Gabelus at Rages, a city of the Medes ? And when you shall return, I will pay you your hire.
text_la: Dixit itaque illi Tobias : Numquid poteris perducere filium meum ad Gabelum in Rages civitatem Medorum? et cum redieris, restituam tibi mercedem tuam.
text_pt: Então lhe disseram Zeres, sua mulher, e todos os seus amigos: Faça-se uma forca de cinqüenta côvados de altura, e amanhã dize ao rei que nela seja enforcado Mardoqueu; e então entra alegre com o rei ao banquete. E este conselho bem pareceu a Hamã, que mandou fazer a forca.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὑγιαίνων ἔλθοις ἄδελφε καὶ μή μοι ὀργισθῇς ὅτι ἐζήτησα τὴν φυλήν σου καὶ τὴν πατριάν σου ἐπιγνῶναι καὶ σὺ τυγχάνεις ἀδελφός μου ἐκ τῆς καλῆς καὶ ἀγαθῆς γενεᾶς ἐπεγίνωσκον γὰρ ἐγὼ Ανανιαν καὶ Ιαθαν τοὺς υἱοὺς Σεμειου τοῦ μεγάλου ὡς ἐπορευόμεθα κοινῶς εἰς Ιεροσόλυμα προσκυνεῖν ἀναφέροντες τὰ πρωτότοκα καὶ τὰς δεκάτας τῶν γενημάτων καὶ οὐκ ἐπλανήθησαν ἐν τῇ πλάνῃ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν ἐκ ῥίζης καλῆς εἶ ἄδελφε

text_en: And the angel said to him: I will conduct him thither, and bring him back to you.
text_la: Et dixit ei angelus : Ego ducam, et reducam eum ad te.
text_el: ἀλλ' εἰπόν μοι τίνα σοι ἔσομαι μισθὸν διδόναι δραχμὴν τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ δέοντά σοι ὡς καὶ τῷ υἱῷ μου

text_en: And Tobias said to him: I pray you, tell me, of what family , or what tribe are you?
text_la: Cui Tobias respondit : Rogo te, indica mihi de qua domo aut de qua tribu es tu.
text_el: καὶ ἔτι προσθήσω σοι ἐπὶ τὸν μισθόν ἐὰν ὑγιαίνοντες ἐπιστρέψητε

text_en: And Raphael the angel answered: Do you seek the family of him you hire, or the hired servant himself to go with your son?
text_la: Cui Raphaël angelus dixit : Genus quæris mercenarii, an ipsum mercenarium qui cum filio tuo eat?
text_el: καὶ εὐδόκησαν οὕτως καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Τωβιαν ἕτοιμος γίνου πρὸς τὴν ὁδόν καὶ εὐοδωθείητε καὶ ἡτοίμασεν ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς τὴν ὁδόν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ πορεύου μετὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὁ δὲ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ οἰκῶν θεὸς εὐοδώσει τὴν ὁδὸν ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτοῦ συμπορευθήτω ὑμῖν καὶ ἐξῆλθαν ἀμφότεροι ἀπελθεῖν καὶ ὁ κύων τοῦ παιδαρίου μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: But lest I should make you uneasy, I am Azarias the son of the great Ananias.
text_la: sed ne forte sollicitum te reddam, ego sum Azarias Ananiæ magni filius.
text_el: ἔκλαυσεν δὲ Αννα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Τωβιτ τί ἐξαπέστειλας τὸ παιδίον ἡμῶν ἢ οὐχὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς χειρὸς ἡμῶν ἐστιν ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι αὐτὸν καὶ ἐκπορεύεσθαι ἐνώπιον ἡμῶν

text_en: And Tobias answered: You are of a great family . But I pray you be not angry that I desired to know your family .
text_la: Et Tobias respondit : Ex magno genere es tu. Sed peto ne irascaris quod voluerim cognoscere genus tuum.
text_el: ἀργύριον τῷ ἀργυρίῳ μὴ φθάσαι ἀλλὰ περίψημα τοῦ παιδίου ἡμῶν γένοιτο

text_en: And the angel said to him: I will lead your son safe, and bring him to you again safe.
text_la: Dixit autem illi angelus : Ego sanum ducam, et sanum tibi reducam filium tuum.
text_el: ὡς γὰρ δέδοται ἡμῖν ζῆν παρὰ τοῦ κυρίου τοῦτο ἱκανὸν ἡμῖν ὑπάρχει

text_en: And Tobias answering, said: May you have a good journey, and God be with you in your way, and his angel accompany you.
text_la: Respondens autem Tobias, ait : Bene ambuletis, et sit Deus in itinere vestro, et angelus ejus comitetur vobiscum.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Τωβιτ μὴ λόγον ἔχε ἀδελφή ὑγιαίνων ἐλεύσεται καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου ὄψονται αὐτόν

text_en: Then all things being ready, that were to be carried in their journey, Tobias bade his father and his mother farewell, and they set out both together.
text_la: Tunc paratis omnibus quæ erant in via portanda, fecit Tobias vale patri suo et matri suæ, et ambulaverunt ambo simul.
text_el: ἄγγελος γὰρ ἀγαθὸς συμπορεύσεται αὐτῷ καὶ εὐοδωθήσεται ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑποστρέψει ὑγιαίνων

text_en: And when they were departed, his mother began to weep, and to say: You have taken the staff of our old age, and sent him away from us.
text_la: Cumque profecti essent, cœpit mater ejus flere, et dicere : Baculum senectutis nostræ tulisti, et transmisisti a nobis.
text_el: καὶ ἐπαύσατο κλαίουσα

text_en: I wish the money for which you have sent him, had never been.
text_la: Numquam fuisset ipsa pecunia, pro qua misisti eum:

text_en: For our poverty was sufficient for us, that we might account it as riches, that we saw our son.
text_la: sufficiebat enim nobis paupertas nostra, ut divitias computaremus hoc, quod videbamus filium nostrum.

text_en: And Tobias said to her: Weep not, our son will arrive thither safe, and will return safe to us, and your eyes shall see him.
text_la: Dixitque ei Tobias : Noli flere : salvus perveniet filius noster, et salvus revertetur ad nos, et oculi tui videbunt illum.

text_en: For I believe that the good angel of God does accompany him, and does order all things well that are done about him, so that he shall return to us with joy .
text_la: Credo enim quod angelus Dei bonus comitetur ei, et bene disponat omnia quæ circa eum geruntur, ita ut cum gaudio revertatur ad nos.

text_en: At these words his mother ceased weeping, and held her peace.
text_la: Ad hanc vocem cessavit mater ejus flere, et tacuit.

text_en: And Tobias went forward, and the dog followed him, and he lodged the first night by the river of Tigris.
text_la: Profectus est autem Tobias, et canis secutus est eum, et mansit prima mansione juxta fluvium Tigris.
text_pt: Naquela mesma noite fugiu o sono do rei; então mandou trazer o livro de registro das crônicas, as quais se leram diante do rei.
text_el: οἱ δὲ πορευόμενοι τὴν ὁδὸν ἦλθον ἑσπέρας ἐπὶ τὸν Τίγριν ποταμὸν καὶ ηὐλίζοντο ἐκεῖ

text_en: And he went out to wash his feet , and behold a monstrous fish came up to devour him.
text_la: Et exivit ut lavaret pedes suos, et ecce piscis immanis exivit ad devorandum eum.
text_pt: E achou-se escrito que Mardoqueu tinha denunciado Bigtã e Teres, dois dos camareiros do rei, da guarda da porta, que tinham procurado lançar mão do rei Assuero.
text_el: τὸ δὲ παιδάριον κατέβη περικλύσασθαι καὶ ἀνεπήδησεν ἰχθὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ ἐβουλήθη καταπιεῖν τὸ παιδάριον

text_en: And Tobias being afraid of him, cried out with a loud voice, saying: Sir, he comes upon me.
text_la: Quem expavescens Tobias clamavit voce magna, dicens : Domine, invadit me.
text_pt: Então disse o rei: Que honra e distinção se deu por isso a Mardoqueu? E os servos do rei, que ministravam junto a ele, disseram: Coisa nenhuma se lhe fez.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἐπιλαβοῦ τοῦ ἰχθύος καὶ ἐκράτησεν τὸν ἰχθὺν τὸ παιδάριον καὶ ἀνέβαλεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And the angel said to him: Take him by the gill, and draw him to you. And when he had done so, he drew him out upon the land, and he began to pant before his feet.
text_la: Et dixit ei angelus : Apprehende branchiam ejus, et trahe eum ad te. Quod cum fecisset, attraxit eum in siccum, et palpitare cœpit ante pedes ejus.
text_pt: Então disse o rei: Quem está no pátio? E Hamã tinha entrado no pátio exterior da casa do rei, para dizer ao rei que enforcassem a Mardoqueu na forca que lhe tinha preparado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος ἀνάτεμε τὸν ἰχθὺν καὶ λαβὼν τὴν καρδίαν καὶ τὸ ἧπαρ καὶ τὴν χολὴν θὲς ἀσφαλῶς

text_en: Then the angel said to him: Take out the entrails of this fish, and lay up his heart, and his gall, and his liver for you: for these are necessary for useful medicines.
text_la: Tunc dixit ei angelus : Exentera hunc piscem, et cor ejus, et fel, et jecur repone tibi : sunt enim hæc necessaria ad medicamenta utiliter.
text_pt: E os servos do rei lhe disseram: Eis que Hamã está no pátio. E disse o rei que entrasse.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ παιδάριον ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος τὸν δὲ ἰχθὺν ὀπτήσαντες ἔφαγον

text_en: And when he had done so, he roasted the flesh thereof, and they took it with them in the way: the rest they salted as much as might serve them, till they came to Rages the city of the Medes .
text_la: Quod cum fecisset, assavit carnes ejus, et secum tulerunt in via : cetera salierunt, quæ sufficerent eis, quousque pervenirent in Rages civitatem Medorum.
text_pt: E, entrando Hamã, o rei lhe disse: Que se fará ao homem de cuja honra o rei se agrada? Então Hamã disse no seu coração: De quem se agradaria o rei para lhe fazer honra mais do que a mim?
text_el: καὶ ὥδευον ἀμφότεροι ἕως ἤγγισαν ἐν Ἐκβατάνοις

text_en: Then Tobias asked the angel , and said to him: I beseech you, brother Azarias, tell me what remedies are these things good for, which you have bid me keep of the fish?
text_la: Tunc interrogavit Tobias angelum, et dixit ei : Obsecro te, Azaria frater, ut dicas mihi quod remedium habebunt ista, quæ de pisce servare jussisti?
text_pt: Assim disse Hamã ao rei: Para o homem, de cuja honra o rei se agrada,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τὸ παιδάριον τῷ ἀγγέλῳ Αζαρια ἄδελφε τί ἐστιν τὸ ἧπαρ καὶ ἡ καρδία καὶ ἡ χολὴ τοῦ ἰχθύος

text_en: And the angel , answering, said to him: If you put a little piece of its heart upon coals, the smoke thereof drives away all kind of devils , either from man or from woman , so that they come no more to them.
text_la: Et respondens angelus, dixit ei : Cordis ejus particulam si super carbones ponas, fumus ejus extricat omne genus dæmoniorum sive a viro, sive a muliere, ita ut ultra non accedat ad eos.
text_pt: Tragam a veste real que o rei costuma vestir, como também o cavalo em que o rei costuma andar montado, e ponha-se-lhe a coroa real na sua cabeça.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἡ καρδία καὶ τὸ ἧπαρ ἐάν τινα ὀχλῇ δαιμόνιον ἢ πνεῦμα πονηρόν ταῦτα δεῖ καπνίσαι ἐνώπιον ἀνθρώπου ἢ γυναικός καὶ οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ ὀχληθῇ

text_en: And the gall is good for anointing the eyes, in which there is a white speck, and they shall be cured.
text_la: Et fel valet ad ungendos oculos in quibus fuerit albugo, et sanabuntur.
text_pt: E entregue-se a veste e o cavalo à mão de um dos príncipes mais nobres do rei, e vistam delas aquele homem a quem o rei deseja honrar; e levem-no a cavalo pelas ruas da cidade, e apregoe-se diante dele: Assim se fará ao homem a quem o rei deseja honrar!
text_el: ἡ δὲ χολή ἐγχρῖσαι ἄνθρωπον ὃς ἔχει λευκώματα ἐν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ ἰαθήσεται

text_en: And Tobias said to him: Where will you that we lodge?
text_la: Et dixit ei Tobias : Ubi vis ut maneamus?
text_pt: Então disse o rei a Hamã: Apressa-te, toma a veste e o cavalo, como disseste, e faze assim para com o judeu Mardoqueu, que está assentado à porta do rei; e coisa nenhuma omitas de tudo quanto disseste.
text_el: ὡς δὲ προσήγγισαν τῇ Ραγη

text_en: And the angel answering, said: Here is one whose name is Raguel, a near kinsman of your tribe, and he has a daughter named Sara, but he has no son nor any other daughter beside her.
text_la: Respondensque angelus, ait : Est hic Raguel nomine, vir propinquus de tribu tua, et hic habet filiam nomine Saram, sed neque masculum neque feminam ullam habet aliam præter eam.
text_pt: E Hamã tomou a veste e o cavalo, e vestiu a Mardoqueu, e o levou a cavalo pelas ruas da cidade, e apregoou diante dele: Assim se fará ao homem a quem o rei deseja honrar!
text_el: εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος τῷ παιδαρίῳ ἄδελφε σήμερον αὐλισθησόμεθα παρὰ Ραγουηλ καὶ αὐτὸς συγγενής σού ἐστιν καὶ ἔστιν αὐτῷ θυγάτηρ μονογενὴς ὀνόματι Σαρρα

text_en: All his substance is due to you, and you must take her to wife.
text_la: Tibi debetur omnis substantia ejus, et oportet eam te accipere conjugem.
text_pt: Depois disto Mardoqueu voltou para a porta do rei; porém Hamã se retirou correndo à sua casa, triste, e de cabeça coberta.
text_el: λαλήσω περὶ αὐτῆς τοῦ δοθῆναί σοι αὐτὴν εἰς γυναῖκα ὅτι σοὶ ἐπιβάλλει ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῆς καὶ σὺ μόνος εἶ ἐκ τοῦ γένους αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ κοράσιον καλὸν καὶ φρόνιμόν ἐστιν

text_en: Ask her therefore of her father, and he will give her you to wife.
text_la: Pete ergo eam a patre ejus, et dabit tibi eam in uxorem.
text_pt: E contou Hamã a Zeres, sua mulher, e a todos os seus amigos, tudo quanto lhe tinha sucedido. Então os seus sábios e Zeres, sua mulher, lhe disseram: Se Mardoqueu, diante de quem já começaste a cair, é da descendência dos judeus, não prevalecerás contra ele, antes certamente cairás diante dele.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἄκουσόν μου καὶ λαλήσω τῷ πατρὶ αὐτῆς καὶ ὅταν ὑποστρέψωμεν ἐκ Ῥάγων ποιήσομεν τὸν γάμον διότι ἐπίσταμαι Ραγουηλ ὅτι οὐ μὴ δῷ αὐτὴν ἀνδρὶ ἑτέρῳ κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωυσῆ ἢ ὀφειλέσει θάνατον ὅτι τὴν κληρονομίαν σοὶ καθήκει λαβεῖν ἢ πάντα ἄνθρωπον

text_en: Then Tobias answered, and said: I hear that she has been given to seven husbands, and they all died: moreover I have heard, that a devil killed them.
text_la: Tunc respondit Tobias, et dixit : Audio quia tradita est septem viris, et mortui sunt : sed et hoc audivi, quia dæmonium occidit illos.
text_pt: E estando eles ainda falando com ele, chegaram os camareiros do rei, e se apressaram a levar Hamã ao banquete que Ester preparara.
text_el: τότε εἶπεν τὸ παιδάριον τῷ ἀγγέλῳ Αζαρια ἄδελφε ἀκήκοα ἐγὼ τὸ κοράσιον δεδόσθαι ἑπτὰ ἀνδράσιν καὶ πάντας ἐν τῷ νυμφῶνι ἀπολωλότας

text_en: Now I am afraid, lest the same thing should happen to me also: and whereas I am the only child of my parents, I should bring down their old age with sorrow to hell.
text_la: Timeo ergo, ne forte et mihi hæc eveniant : et cum sim unicus parentibus meis, deponam senectutem illorum cum tristitia ad inferos.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐγὼ μόνος εἰμὶ τῷ πατρὶ καὶ φοβοῦμαι μὴ εἰσελθὼν ἀποθάνω καθὼς καὶ οἱ πρότεροι ὅτι δαιμόνιον φιλεῖ αὐτήν ὃ οὐκ ἀδικεῖ οὐδένα πλὴν τῶν προσαγόντων αὐτῇ καὶ νῦν ἐγὼ φοβοῦμαι μὴ ἀποθάνω καὶ κατάξω τὴν ζωὴν τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ τῆς μητρός μου μετ' ὀδύνης ἐπ' ἐμοὶ εἰς τὸν τάφον αὐτῶν καὶ υἱὸς ἕτερος οὐχ ὑπάρχει αὐτοῖς ὃς θάψει αὐτούς

text_en: Then the angel Raphael said to him: Hear me, and I will show you who they are, over whom the devil can prevail.
text_la: Tunc angelus Raphaël dixit ei : Audi me, et ostendam tibi qui sunt, quibus prævalere potest dæmonium.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος οὐ μέμνησαι τῶν λόγων ὧν ἐνετείλατό σοι ὁ πατήρ σου ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαβεῖν σε γυναῖκα ἐκ τοῦ γένους σου καὶ νῦν ἄκουσόν μου ἄδελφε διότι σοὶ ἔσται εἰς γυναῖκα καὶ τοῦ δαιμονίου μηδένα λόγον ἔχε ὅτι τὴν νύκτα ταύτην δοθήσεταί σοι αὕτη εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: For they who in such manner receive matrimony, as to shut out God from themselves, and from their mind, and to give themselves to their lust , as the horse and mule, which have not understanding, over them the devil has power.
text_la: Hi namque qui conjugium ita suscipiunt, ut Deum a se et a sua mente excludant, et suæ libidini ita vacent sicut equus et mulus quibus non est intellectus : habet potestatem dæmonium super eos.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃς εἰς τὸν νυμφῶνα λήμψῃ τέφραν θυμιαμάτων καὶ ἐπιθήσεις ἀπὸ τῆς καρδίας καὶ τοῦ ἥπατος τοῦ ἰχθύος καὶ καπνίσεις καὶ ὀσφρανθήσεται τὸ δαιμόνιον καὶ φεύξεται καὶ οὐκ ἐπανελεύσεται τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: But you when you shall take her, go into the chamber, and for three days keep yourself continent from her, and give yourself to nothing else but to prayers with her.
text_la: Tu autem cum acceperis eam, ingressus cubiculum, per tres dies continens esto ab ea, et nihil aliud nisi orationibus vacabis cum ea.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ προσπορεύῃ αὐτῇ ἐγέρθητε ἀμφότεροι καὶ βοήσατε πρὸς τὸν ἐλεήμονα θεόν καὶ σώσει ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐλεήσει μὴ φοβοῦ ὅτι σοὶ αὐτὴ ἡτοιμασμένη ἦν ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ σὺ αὐτὴν σώσεις καὶ πορεύσεται μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ὑπολαμβάνω ὅτι σοὶ ἔσται ἐξ αὐτῆς παιδία

text_en: And on that night lay the liver of the fish on the fire, and the devil shall be driven away.
text_la: Ipsa autem nocte, incenso jecore piscis, fugabitur dæmonium.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἤκουσεν Τωβιας ταῦτα ἐφίλησεν αὐτήν καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐκολλήθη αὐτῇ σφόδρα

text_en: But the second night you shall be admitted into the society of the holy Patriarchs.
text_la: Secunda vero nocte in copulatione sanctorum patriarcharum admitteris.

text_en: And the third night you shall obtain a blessing that sound children may be born of you.
text_la: Tertia autem nocte, benedictionem consequeris, ut filii ex vobis procreentur incolumes.

text_en: And when the third night is past, you shall take the virgin with the fear of the Lord , moved rather for love of children than for lust , that in the seed of Abraham you may obtain a blessing in children.
text_la: Transacta autem tertia nocte, accipies virginem cum timore Domini, amore filiorum magis quam libidine ductus, ut in semine Abrahæ benedictionem in filiis consequaris.

text_en: And they went in to Raguel, and Raguel received them with joy .
text_la: Ingressi sunt autem ad Raguelem, et suscepit eos Raguel cum gaudio.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, o rei com Hamã, para beber com a rainha Ester,
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ἐκβάτανα καὶ παρεγένοντο εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Ραγουηλ Σαρρα δὲ ὑπήντησεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐχαιρέτισεν αὐτοὺς καὶ αὐτοὶ αὐτήν καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν

text_en: And Raguel looking upon Tobias, said to Anna his wife: How like is this young man to my cousin?
text_la: Intuensque Tobiam Raguel, dixit Annæ uxori suæ : Quam similis est juvenis iste consobrino meo!
text_pt: Disse outra vez o rei a Ester, no segundo dia, no banquete do vinho: Qual é a tua petição, rainha Ester? E se te dará. E qual é o teu desejo? Até metade do reino, se te dará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ραγουηλ Εδνα τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς ὅμοιος ὁ νεανίσκος Τωβιτ τῷ ἀνεψιῷ μου

text_en: And when he had spoken these words, he said: Whence are you young men our brethren?
text_la: Et cum hæc dixisset, ait : Unde estis juvenes fratres nostri? At illi dixerunt : Ex tribu Nephthali sumus, ex captivitate Ninive.
text_pt: Então respondeu a rainha Ester, e disse: Se, ó rei, achei graça aos teus olhos, e se bem parecer ao rei, dê-se-me a minha vida como minha petição, e o meu povo como meu desejo.
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησεν αὐτοὺς Ραγουηλ πόθεν ἐστέ ἀδελφοί καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Νεφθαλι τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐν Νινευη

text_en: But they said: We are of the tribe of Nephtali , of the captivity of Ninive.
text_la: Dixitque illis Raguel : Nostis Tobiam fratrem meum? Qui dixerunt : Novimus.
text_pt: Porque fomos vendidos, eu e o meu povo, para nos destruírem, matarem, e aniquilarem de vez; se ainda por servos e por servas nos vendessem, calar-me-ia; ainda que o opressor não poderia ter compensado a perda do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς γινώσκετε Τωβιτ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν οἱ δὲ εἶπαν γινώσκομεν

text_en: And Raguel said to them: Do you know Tobias my brother? And they said: We know him.
text_la: Cumque multa bona loqueretur de eo, dixit angelus ad Raguelem : Tobias, de quo interrogas, pater istius est.
text_pt: Então falou o rei Assuero, e disse à rainha Ester: Quem é esse e onde está esse, cujo coração o instigou a assim fazer?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὑγιαίνει οἱ δὲ εἶπαν καὶ ζῇ καὶ ὑγιαίνει καὶ εἶπεν Τωβιας πατήρ μού ἐστιν

text_en: And when he was speaking many good things of him, the angel said to Raguel: Tobias concerning whom you inquire is this young man's father.
text_la: Et misit se Raguel, et cum lacrimis osculatus est eum, et plorans supra collum ejus
text_pt: E disse Ester: O homem, o opressor, e o inimigo, é este mau Hamã. Então Hamã se perturbou perante o rei e a rainha.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεπήδησεν Ραγουηλ καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἔκλαυσε καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ τοῦ καλοῦ καὶ ἀγαθοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἀκούσας ὅτι Τωβιτ ἀπώλεσεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐλυπήθη καὶ ἔκλαυσεν

text_en: And Raguel went to him, and kissed him with tears and weeping upon his neck, said: A blessing be upon you, my son, because you are the son of a good and most virtuous man .
text_la: dixit : Benedictio sit tibi, fili mi, quia boni et optimi viri filius es.
text_pt: E o rei no seu furor se levantou do banquete do vinho e passou para o jardim do palácio; e Hamã se pôs em pé, para rogar à rainha Ester pela sua vida; porque viu que já o mal lhe estava determinado pelo rei.
text_el: καὶ Εδνα ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ Σαρρα ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτοῦ ἔκλαυσαν καὶ ὑπεδέξαντο αὐτοὺς προθύμως

text_en: And Anna his wife, and Sara their daughter wept.
text_la: Et Anna uxor ejus, et Sara ipsorum filia, lacrimatæ sunt.
text_pt: Tornando, pois, o rei do jardim do palácio à casa do banquete do vinho, Hamã tinha caído prostrado sobre o leito em que estava Ester. Então disse o rei: Porventura quereria ele também forçar a rainha perante mim nesta casa? Saindo esta palavra da boca do rei, cobriram o rosto de Hamã.
text_el: καὶ ἔθυσαν κριὸν προβάτων καὶ παρέθηκαν ὄψα πλείονα

text_en: And after they had spoken, Raguel commanded a sheep to be killed, and a feast to be prepared. And when he desired them to sit down to dinner,
text_la: Postquam autem locuti sunt, præcepit Raguel occidi arietem, et parari convivium. Cumque hortaretur eos discumbere ad prandium,
text_pt: Então disse Harbona, um dos camareiros que serviam diante do rei: Eis que também a forca de cinqüenta côvados de altura que Hamã fizera para Mardoqueu, que falara em defesa do rei, está junto à casa de Hamã. Então disse o rei: Enforcai-o nela.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Τωβιας τῷ Ραφαηλ Αζαρια ἄδελφε λάλησον ὑπὲρ ὧν ἔλεγες ἐν τῇ πορείᾳ καὶ τελεσθήτω τὸ πρᾶγμα

text_en: Tobias said: I will not eat nor drink here this day, unless you first grant me my petition, and promise to give me Sara your daughter.
text_la: Tobias dixit : Hic ego hodie non manducabo neque bibam, nisi prius petitionem meam confirmes, et promittas mihi dare Saram filiam tuam.
text_pt: Enforcaram, pois, a Hamã na forca, que ele tinha preparado para Mardoqueu. Então o furor do rei se aplacou.
text_el: καὶ μετέδωκεν τὸν λόγον τῷ Ραγουηλ καὶ εἶπεν Ραγουηλ πρὸς Τωβιαν φάγε καὶ πίε καὶ ἡδέως γίνου σοὶ γὰρ καθήκει τὸ παιδίον μου λαβεῖν πλὴν ὑποδείξω σοι τὴν ἀλήθειαν

text_en: Now when Raguel heard this he was afraid, knowing what had happened to those seven husbands, that went in unto her: and he began to fear lest it might happen to him also in like manner: and as he was in suspense, and gave no answer to his petition,
text_la: Quo audito verbo Raguel expavit, sciens quid evenerit illis septem viris qui ingressi sunt ad eam : et timere cœpit ne forte et hunc similiter contingeret. Et cum nutaret, et non daret petenti ullum responsum,
text_el: ἔδωκα τὸ παιδίον μου ἑπτὰ ἀνδράσιν καὶ ὁπότε ἐὰν εἰσεπορεύοντο πρὸς αὐτήν ἀπεθνῄσκοσαν ὑπὸ τὴν νύκτα ἀλλὰ τὸ νῦν ἔχων ἡδέως γίνου

text_en: the angel said to him: Be not afraid to give her to this man , for to him who fears God is your daughter due to be his wife: therefore another could not have her.
text_la: dixit ei angelus : Noli timere dare eam isti, quoniam huic timenti Deum debetur conjux filia tua : propterea alius non potuit habere illam.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Τωβιας οὐ γεύσομαι οὐδὲν ὧδε ἕως ἂν στήσητε καὶ σταθῆτε πρός με καὶ εἶπεν Ραγουηλ κομίζου αὐτὴν ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν κατὰ τὴν κρίσιν σὺ δὲ ἀδελφὸς εἶ αὐτῆς καὶ αὐτή σού ἐστιν ὁ δὲ ἐλεήμων θεὸς εὐοδώσει ὑμῖν τὰ κάλλιστα

text_en: Then Raguel said: I doubt not but God has regarded my prayers and tears in his sight.
text_la: Tunc dixit Raguel : Non dubito quod Deus preces et lacrimas meas in conspectu suo admiserit.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Σαρραν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ λαβὼν τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς παρέδωκεν αὐτὴν τῷ Τωβια γυναῖκα καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωυσέως κομίζου αὐτὴν καὶ ἄπαγε πρὸς τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς

text_en: And I believe he has therefore made you come to me, that this maid might be married to one of her own kindred, according to the law of Moses : and now doubt not but I will give her to you.
text_la: Et credo quoniam ideo fecit vos venire ad me, ut ista conjungeretur cognationi suæ secundum legem Moysi : et nunc noli dubium gerere quod tibi eam tradam.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Εδναν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ λαβὼν βιβλίον ἔγραψεν συγγραφήν καὶ ἐσφραγίσαντο καὶ ἤρξαντο ἐσθίειν

text_en: And taking the right hand of his daughter, he gave it into the right hand of Tobias, saying: The God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob be with you, and may he join you together, and fulfil his blessing in you.
text_la: Et apprehendens dexteram filiæ suæ, dexteræ Tobiæ tradidit, dicens : Deus Abraham, et Deus Isaac, et Deus Jacob vobiscum sit, et ipse conjungat vos, impleatque benedictionem suam in vobis.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ραγουηλ Εδναν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ἀδελφή ἑτοίμασον τὸ ἕτερον ταμίειον καὶ εἰσάγαγε αὐτήν

text_en: And taking paper they made a writing of the marriage.
text_la: Et accepta carta, fecerunt conscriptionem conjugii.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὡς εἶπεν καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὴν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἔκλαυσεν καὶ ἀπεδέξατο τὰ δάκρυα τῆς θυγατρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ

text_en: And afterwards they made merry, blessing God .
text_la: Et post hæc epulati sunt, benedicentes Deum.
text_el: θάρσει τέκνον ὁ κύριος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς δῴη σοι χάριν ἀντὶ τῆς λύπης σου ταύτης θάρσει θύγατερ

text_en: And Raguel called to him Anna his wife, and bade her to prepare another chamber.
text_la: Vocavitque Raguel ad se Annam uxorem suam, et præcepit ei ut præpararet alterum cubiculum.

text_en: And she brought Sara her daughter in thither, and she wept.
text_la: Et introduxit illuc Saram filiam suam, et lacrimata est.
