text_en: And she said to her: Be of good cheer, my daughter: the Lord of heaven give you joy for the trouble you have undergone.
text_la: Dixitque ei : Forti animo esto, filia mea : Dominus cæli det tibi gaudium pro tædio quod perpessa es.

text_en: And after they had supped, they brought in the young man to her.
text_la: Postquam vero cœnaverunt, introduxerunt juvenem ad eam.
text_pt: Naquele mesmo dia deu o rei Assuero à rainha Ester a casa de Hamã, inimigo dos judeus; e Mardoqueu veio perante o rei, porque Ester tinha declarado quem ele era.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ συνετέλεσαν δειπνοῦντες εἰσήγαγον Τωβιαν πρὸς αὐτήν

text_en: And Tobias remembering the angel's word, took out of his bag part of the liver, and laid it upon burning coals.
text_la: Recordatus itaque Tobias sermonum angeli, protulit de cassidili suo partem jecoris, posuitque eam super carbones vivos.
text_pt: E tirou o rei o seu anel, que tinha tomado de Hamã, e o deu a Mardoqueu. E Ester encarregou Mardoqueu da casa de Hamã.
text_el: ὁ δὲ πορευόμενος ἐμνήσθη τῶν λόγων Ραφαηλ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν τέφραν τῶν θυμιαμάτων καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὴν καρδίαν τοῦ ἰχθύος καὶ τὸ ἧπαρ καὶ ἐκάπνισεν

text_en: Then the angel Raphael took the devil , and bound him in the desert of upper Egypt .
text_la: Tunc Raphaël angelus apprehendit dæmonium, et religavit illud in deserto superioris Ægypti.
text_pt: Falou mais Ester perante o rei, e se lhe lançou aos seus pés; e chorou, e lhe suplicou que revogasse a maldade de Hamã, o agagita, e o intento que tinha projetado contra os judeus.
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ὠσφράνθη τὸ δαιμόνιον τῆς ὀσμῆς ἔφυγεν εἰς τὰ ἀνώτατα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸ ὁ ἄγγελος

text_en: Then Tobias exhorted the virgin, and said to her: Sara, arise, and let us pray to God to day, and tomorrow, and the next day: because for these three nights we are joined to God : and when the third night is over, we will be in our own wedlock.
text_la: Tunc hortatus est virginem Tobias, dixitque ei : Sara, exsurge, et deprecemur Deum hodie, et cras, et secundum cras : quia his tribus noctibus Deo jungimur; tertia autem transacta nocte, in nostro erimus conjugio.
text_pt: E estendeu o rei para Ester o cetro de ouro. Então Ester se levantou, e pôs-se em pé perante o rei,
text_el: ὡς δὲ συνεκλείσθησαν ἀμφότεροι ἀνέστη Τωβιας ἀπὸ τῆς κλίνης καὶ εἶπεν ἀνάστηθι ἀδελφή καὶ προσευξώμεθα ἵνα ἡμᾶς ἐλεήσῃ ὁ κύριος

text_en: For we are the children of saints, and we must not be joined together like heathens that know not God .
text_la: Filii quippe sanctorum sumus, et non possumus ita conjungi sicut gentes quæ ignorant Deum.
text_pt: E disse: Se bem parecer ao rei, e se eu achei graça perante ele, e se este negócio é reto diante do rei, e se eu lhe agrado aos seus olhos, escreva-se que se revoguem as cartas concebidas por Hamã filho de Hamedata, o agagita, as quais ele escreveu para aniquilar os judeus, que estão em todas as províncias do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξατο Τωβιας λέγειν εὐλογητὸς εἶ ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ εὐλογητὸν τὸ ὄνομά σου τὸ ἅγιον καὶ ἔνδοξον εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας εὐλογησάτωσάν σε οἱ οὐρανοὶ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ κτίσεις σου

text_en: So they both arose, and prayed earnestly both together that health might be given them,
text_la: Surgentes autem pariter, instanter orabant ambo simul, ut sanitas daretur eis.
text_pt: Pois como poderei ver o mal que sobrevirá ao meu povo? E como poderei ver a destruição da minha parentela?
text_el: σὺ ἐποίησας Αδαμ καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ βοηθὸν Ευαν στήριγμα τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τούτων ἐγενήθη τὸ ἀνθρώπων σπέρμα σὺ εἶπας οὐ καλὸν εἶναι τὸν ἄνθρωπον μόνον ποιήσωμεν αὐτῷ βοηθὸν ὅμοιον αὐτῷ

text_en: and Tobias said: Lord God of our fathers, may the heavens and the earth, and the sea, and the fountains, and the rivers, and all your creatures that are in them, bless you.
text_la: Dixitque Tobias : Domine Deus patrum nostrorum, benedicant te cæli et terræ, mareque et fontes, et flumina, et omnes creaturæ tuæ quæ in eis sunt.
text_pt: Então disse o rei Assuero à rainha Ester e ao judeu Mardoqueu: Eis que dei a Ester a casa de Hamã, e a ele penduraram numa forca, porquanto estendera as mãos contra os judeus.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε οὐ διὰ πορνείαν ἐγὼ λαμβάνω τὴν ἀδελφήν μου ταύτην ἀλλ' ἐπ' ἀληθείας ἐπίταξον ἐλεῆσαί με καὶ ταύτῃ συγκαταγηρᾶσαι

text_en: You made Adam of the slime of the earth, and gave him Eve for a helper.
text_la: Tu fecisti Adam de limo terræ, dedistique ei adjutorium Hevam.
text_pt: Escrevei, pois, aos judeus, como parecer bem aos vossos olhos, em nome do rei, e selai-o com o anel do rei; porque o documento que se escreve em nome do rei, e que se sela com o anel do rei, não se pode revogar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν μετ' αὐτοῦ αμην

text_en: And now, Lord , you know, that not for fleshly lust do I take my sister to wife, but only for the love of posterity, in which your name may be blessed for ever and ever.
text_la: Et nunc Domine, tu scis quia non luxuriæ causa accipio sororem meam conjugem, sed sola posteritatis dilectione, in qua benedicatur nomen tuum in sæcula sæculorum.
text_pt: Então foram chamados os escrivães do rei, naquele mesmo tempo, no terceiro mês (que é o mês de Sivã), aos vinte e três dias; e se escreveu conforme a tudo quanto ordenou Mardoqueu aos judeus, como também aos sátrapas, e aos governadores, e aos líderes das províncias, que se estendem da Úndia até Etiópia, cento e vinte e sete províncias, a cada província segundo o seu modo de escrever, e a cada povo conforme a sua língua; como também aos judeus segundo o seu modo de escrever, e conforme a sua língua.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθησαν ἀμφότεροι τὴν νύκτα

text_en: Sara also said: Have mercy on us, O Lord , have mercy on us, and let us grow old both together in health.
text_la: Dixit quoque Sara : Miserere nobis Domine, miserere nobis, et consenescamus ambo pariter sani.
text_pt: E escreveu-se em nome do rei Assuero e, selando-as com o anel do rei, enviaram as cartas pela mão de correios a cavalo, que cavalgavam sobre ginetes, que eram das cavalariças do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστὰς Ραγουηλ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ὤρυξεν τάφον λέγων μὴ καὶ οὗτος ἀποθάνῃ

text_en: And it came to pass about the cockcrowing, Raguel ordered his servants to be called for, and they went with him together to dig a grave.
text_la: Et factum est circa pullorum cantum, accersiri jussit Raguel servos suos, et abierunt cum eo pariter ut foderent sepulchrum.
text_pt: Nelas o rei concedia aos judeus, que havia em cada cidade, que se reunissem, e se dispusessem para defenderem as suas vidas, e para destruírem, matarem e aniquilarem todas as forças do povo e da província que viessem contra eles, crianças e mulheres, e que se saqueassem os seus bens,
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ραγουηλ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν ἑαυτοῦ

text_en: For he said: Lest perhaps it may have happened to him, in like manner as it did to the other seven husbands, that went in unto her.
text_la: Dicebat enim : Ne forte simili modo evenerit ei, quo et ceteris illis septem viris qui sunt ingressi ad eam.
text_pt: Num mesmo dia, em todas as províncias do rei Assuero, no dia treze do duodécimo mês, que é o mês de Adar;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εδνα τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπόστειλον μίαν τῶν παιδισκῶν καὶ ἰδέτωσαν εἰ ζῇ εἰ δὲ μή ἵνα θάψωμεν αὐτὸν καὶ μηδεὶς γνῷ

text_en: And when they had prepared the pit, Raguel went back to his wife, and said to her:
text_la: Cumque parassent fossam, reversus Raguel ad uxorem suam, dixit ei:
text_pt: E uma cópia da carta seria divulgada como decreto em todas as províncias, e publicada entre todos os povos, para que os judeus estivessem preparados para aquele dia, para se vingarem dos seus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἡ παιδίσκη ἀνοίξασα τὴν θύραν καὶ εὗρεν τοὺς δύο καθεύδοντας

text_en: Send one of your maids, and let her see if he be dead, that I may bury him before it be day.
text_la: Mitte unam de ancillis tuis, et videat si mortuus est, ut sepeliam eum antequam illucescat dies.
text_pt: Os correios, sobre ginetes velozes, saíram apressuradamente, impelidos pela palavra do rei; e esta ordem foi publicada na fortaleza de Susã.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελθοῦσα ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ζῇ

text_en: So she sent one of her maidservants, who went into the chamber, and found them safe and sound, sleeping both together.
text_la: At illa misit unam ex ancillis suis. Quæ ingressa cubiculum, reperit eos salvos et incolumes, secum pariter dormientes.
text_pt: Então Mardoqueu saiu da presença do rei com veste real azul-celeste e branca, como também com uma grande coroa de ouro, e com uma capa de linho fino e púrpura, e a cidade de Susã exultou e se alegrou.
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησεν Ραγουηλ τὸν θεὸν λέγων εὐλογητὸς εἶ σύ ὁ θεός ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ καθαρᾷ καὶ ἁγίᾳ καὶ εὐλογείτωσάν σε οἱ ἅγιοί σου καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ κτίσεις σου καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοί σου καὶ οἱ ἐκλεκτοί σου εὐλογείτωσάν σε εἰς πάντας τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: And returning she brought the good news: and Raguel and Anna his wife blessed the Lord ,
text_la: Et reversa nuntiavit bonum nuntium : et benedixerunt Dominum, Raguel videlicet et Anna uxor ejus,
text_pt: E para os judeus houve luz, e alegria, e gozo, e honra.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς εἶ ὅτι ηὔφρανάς με καὶ οὐκ ἐγένετό μοι καθὼς ὑπενόουν ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ πολὺ ἔλεός σου ἐποίησας μεθ' ἡμῶν

text_en: and said: We bless you, O Lord God of Israel , because it has not happened as we suspected.
text_la: et dixerunt : Benedicimus te, Domine Deus Israël, quia non contigit quemadmodum putabamus.
text_pt: Também em toda a província, e em toda a cidade, aonde chegava a palavra do rei e a sua ordem, havia entre os judeus alegria e gozo, banquetes e dias de folguedo; e muitos, dos povos da terra, se fizeram judeus, porque o temor dos judeus tinha caído sobre eles.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς εἶ ὅτι ἠλέησας δύο μονογενεῖς ποίησον αὐτοῖς δέσποτα ἔλεος συντέλεσον τὴν ζωὴν αὐτῶν ἐν ὑγιείᾳ μετὰ εὐφροσύνης καὶ ἐλέους

text_en: For you have shown your mercy to us, and have shut out from us the enemy that persecuted us.
text_la: Fecisti enim nobiscum misericordiam tuam, et exclusisti a nobis inimicum persequentem nos.
text_el: ἐκέλευσεν δὲ τοῖς οἰκέταις χῶσαι τὸν τάφον

text_en: And you have taken pity upon two only children. Make them, O Lord , bless you more fully: and to offer up to you a sacrifice of your praise, and of their health, that all nations may know, that you alone are God in all the earth.
text_la: Misertus es autem duobus unicis. Fac eos, Domine, plenius benedicere te, et sacrificium tibi laudis tuæ et suæ sanitatis offerre, ut cognoscat universitas gentium quia tu es Deus solus in universa terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτοῖς γάμον ἡμερῶν δέκα τεσσάρων

text_en: And immediately Raguel commanded his servants, to fill up the pit they had made, before it was day.
text_la: Statimque præcepit servis suis Raguel ut replerent fossam quam fecerant priusquam elucesceret.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ραγουηλ πρὶν ἢ συντελεσθῆναι τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ γάμου ἐνόρκως μὴ ἐξελθεῖν αὐτόν ἐὰν μὴ πληρωθῶσιν αἱ δέκα τέσσαρες ἡμέραι τοῦ γάμου

text_en: And he spoke to his wife to make ready a feast, and prepare all kind of provisions that are necessary for such as go a journey.
text_la: Uxori autem suæ dixit ut instrueret convivium, et præpararet omnia quæ in cibos erant iter agentibus necessaria.
text_el: καὶ τότε λαβόντα τὸ ἥμισυ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτοῦ πορεύεσθαι μετὰ ὑγιείας πρὸς τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὰ λοιπά ὅταν ἀποθάνω καὶ ἡ γυνή μου

text_en: He caused also two fat kine, and four wethers to be killed, and a banquet to be prepared for all his neighbours, and all his friends,
text_la: Duas quoque pingues vaccas, et quatuor arietes, occidi fecit, et parari epulas omnibus vicinis suis, cunctisque amicis.

text_en: and Raguel adjured Tobias, to abide with him two weeks.
text_la: Et adjuravit Raguel Tobiam ut duas hebdomadas moraretur apud se.

text_en: And of all things which Raguel possessed, he gave one half to Tobias, and made a writing, that the half that remained should after their decease come also to Tobias.
text_la: De omnibus autem quæ possidebat Raguel, dimidiam partem dedit Tobiæ, et fecit scripturam, ut pars dimidia quæ supererat, post obitum eorum Tobiæ dominio deveniret.

text_en: Then Tobias called the angel to him, whom he took to be a man , and said to him: Brother Azarias, I pray you hearken to my words:
text_la: Tunc vocavit Tobias angelum ad se, quem quidem hominem existimabat, dixitque ei : Azaria frater, peto ut auscultes verba mea.
text_pt: E, no duodécimo mês, que é o mês de Adar, no dia treze do mesmo mês em que chegou a palavra do rei e a sua ordem para se executar, no dia em que os inimigos dos judeus esperavam assenhorear-se deles, sucedeu o contrário, porque os judeus foram os que se assenhorearam dos que os odiavam.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Τωβιας τὸν Ραφαηλ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ

text_en: If I should give myself to be your servant I should not make a worthy return for your care.
text_la: Si meipsum tradam tibi servum, non ero condignus providentiæ tuæ:
text_pt: Porque os judeus nas suas cidades, em todas as províncias do rei Assuero, se ajuntaram para pôr as mãos naqueles que procuravam o seu mal; e ninguém podia resistir-lhes, porque o medo deles caíra sobre todos aqueles povos.
text_el: Αζαρια ἄδελφε λαβὲ μετὰ σεαυτοῦ παῖδα καὶ δύο καμήλους καὶ πορεύθητι ἐν Ῥάγοις τῆς Μηδίας παρὰ Γαβαηλ καὶ κόμισαί μοι τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ αὐτὸν ἄγε εἰς τὸν γάμον

text_en: However, I beseech you, to take with you beasts and servants, and to go to Gabelus to Rages the city of the Medes : and to restore to him his note of hand, and receive of him the money, and desire him to come to my wedding.
text_la: tamen obsecro te ut assumas tibi animalia sive servitia, et vadas ad Gabelum in Rages civitatem Medorum, reddasque ei chirographum suum, et recipias ab eo pecuniam, et roges eum venire ad nuptias meas.
text_pt: E todos os líderes das províncias, e os sátrapas, e os governadores, e os que faziam a obra do rei, auxiliavam os judeus; porque tinha caído sobre eles o temor de Mardoqueu.
text_el: διότι ὀμώμοκεν Ραγουηλ μὴ ἐξελθεῖν με

text_en: For you know that my father numbers the days: and if I stay one day more, his soul will be afflicted.
text_la: Scis enim ipse quoniam numerat pater meus dies, et si tardavero una die plus, contristatur anima ejus.
text_pt: Porque Mardoqueu era grande na casa do rei, e a sua fama crescia por todas as províncias, porque o homem Mardoqueu ia sendo engrandecido.
text_el: καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ἀριθμεῖ τὰς ἡμέρας καὶ ἐὰν χρονίσω μέγα ὀδυνηθήσεται λίαν

text_en: And indeed you see how Raguel has adjured me, whose adjuring I cannot despise .
text_la: Et certe vides quomodo adjuravit me Raguel, cujus adjuramentum spernere non possum.
text_pt: Feriram, pois, os judeus a todos os seus inimigos, a golpes de espada, com matança e com destruição; e fizeram dos seus inimigos o que quiseram.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ραφαηλ καὶ ηὐλίσθη παρὰ Γαβαήλῳ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὸ χειρόγραφον ὃς δὲ προήνεγκεν τὰ θυλάκια ἐν ταῖς σφραγῖσιν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ

text_en: Then Raphael took four of Raguel's servants, and two camels, and went to Rages the city of the Medes : and finding Gabelus, gave him his note of hand, and received of him all the money.
text_la: Tunc Raphaël assumens quatuor ex servis Raguelis, et duos camelos, in Rages civitatem Medorum perrexit : et inveniens Gabelum, reddidit ei chirographum suum, et recepit ab eo omnem pecuniam.
text_pt: E na fortaleza de Susã os judeus mataram e destruíram quinhentos homens;
text_el: καὶ ὤρθρευσαν κοινῶς καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὸν γάμον καὶ εὐλόγησεν Τωβιας τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he told him concerning Tobias the son of Tobias, all that had been done: and made him come with him to the wedding.
text_la: Indicavitque ei de Tobia filio Tobiæ omnia quæ gesta sunt, fecitque eum secum venire ad nuptias.
text_pt: Como também a Parsandata, e a Dalfom e a Aspata,

text_en: And when he had come into Raguel's house he found Tobias sitting at the table: and he leaped up, and they kissed each other: and Gabelus wept, and blessed God ,
text_la: Cumque ingressus esset domum Raguelis, invenit Tobiam discumbentem : et exiliens, osculati sunt se invicem : et flevit Gabelus, benedixitque Deum,
text_pt: E a Porata, e a Adalia, e a Aridata,

text_en: and said: The God of Israel bless you, because you are the son of a very good and just man , and that fears God , and does almsdeeds :
text_la: et dixit : Benedicat te Deus Israël, quia filius es optimi viri et justi, et timentis Deum, et eleemosynas facientis:
text_pt: E a Farmasta, e a Arisai, e a Aridai, e a Vaisata; ú

text_en: And may a blessing come upon your wife and upon your parents.
text_la: et dicatur benedictio super uxorem tuam, et super parentes vestros,
text_pt: Os dez filhos de Hamã, filho de Hamedata, o inimigo dos judeus, mataram, porém ao despojo não estenderam a sua mão.

text_en: And may you see your children, and your children's children, unto the third and fourth generation : and may your seed be blessed by the God of Israel , who reigns for ever and ever.
text_la: et videatis filios vestros, et filios filiorum vestrorum, usque in tertiam et quartam generationem : et sit semen vestrum benedictum a Deo Israël, qui regnat in sæcula sæculorum.
text_pt: No mesmo dia foi comunicado ao rei o número dos mortos na fortaleza de Susã.

text_en: And when all had said, Amen , they went to the feast: but the marriage feast they celebrated also with the fear of the Lord .
text_la: Cumque omnes dixissent : Amen : accesserunt ad convivium : sed et cum timore Domini nuptiarum convivium exercebant.
text_pt: E disse o rei à rainha Ester: Na fortaleza de Susã os judeus mataram e destruíram quinhentos homens, e os dez filhos de Hamã; nas mais províncias do rei que teriam feito? Qual é, pois, a tua petição? E dar-se-te-á. Ou qual é ainda o teu requerimento? E far-se-á.

text_en: But as Tobias made longer stay upon occasion of the marriage, Tobias his father was solicitous, saying: Why do you think does my son tarry, or why is he detained there?
text_la: Cum vero moras faceret Tobias, causa nuptiarum, sollicitus erat pater ejus Tobias, dicens : Putas quare moratur filius meus, aut quare detentus est ibi?
text_pt: Depois disto impôs o rei Assuero tributo sobre a terra, e sobre as ilhas do mar.
text_el: καὶ Τωβιτ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐλογίζετο ἑκάστης ἡμέρας καὶ ὡς ἐπληρώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς πορείας καὶ οὐκ ἤρχοντο

text_en: Is Gabelus dead, do you think, and no man will pay him the money?
text_la: Putasne Gabelus mortuus est, et nemo reddet illi pecuniam?
text_pt: E todos os atos do seu poder e do seu valor, e o relato da grandeza de Mardoqueu, a quem o rei exaltou, porventura não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis da Média e da Pérsia?
text_el: εἶπεν μήποτε κατῄσχυνται ἢ μήποτε ἀπέθανεν Γαβαηλ καὶ οὐδεὶς δίδωσιν αὐτῷ τὸ ἀργύριον

text_en: And he began to be exceeding sad, both he and Anna his wife with him: and they began both to weep together, because their son did not return to them on the day appointed.
text_la: Cœpit autem contristari nimis ipse, et Anna uxor ejus cum eo : et cœperunt ambo simul flere, eo quod die statuto minime reverteretur filius eorum ad eos.
text_pt: Porque o judeu Mardoqueu foi o segundo depois do rei Assuero, e grande entre os judeus, e estimado pela multidão de seus irmãos, procurando o bem do seu povo, e proclamando a prosperidade de toda a sua descendência.
text_el: καὶ ἐλυπεῖτο λίαν

text_en: But his mother wept and was quite disconsolate, and said: Woe, woe is me, my son; why did we send you to go to a strange country, the light of our eyes, the staff of our old age, the comfort of our life, the hope of our posterity?
text_la: Flebat igitur mater ejus irremediabilibus lacrimis, atque dicebat : Heu, heu me, fili mi! ut quid te misimus peregrinari, lumen oculorum nostrorum, baculum senectutis nostræ, solatium vitæ nostræ, spem posteritatis nostræ?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή ἀπώλετο τὸ παιδίον διότι κεχρόνικεν καὶ ἤρξατο θρηνεῖν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν

text_en: We having all things together in you alone, ought not to have let you go from us.
text_la: omnia simul in te uno habentes, te non debuimus dimittere a nobis.
text_el: οὐ μέλει μοι τέκνον ὅτι ἀφῆκά σε τὸ φῶς τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου

text_en: And Tobias said to her: Hold your peace, and be not troubled, our son is safe: that man with whom we sent him is very trusty.
text_la: Cui dicebat Tobias : Tace, et noli turbari : sanus est filius noster : satis fidelis est vir ille, cum quo misimus eum.
text_el: καὶ Τωβιτ λέγει αὐτῇ σίγα μὴ λόγον ἔχε ὑγιαίνει

text_en: But she could by no means be comforted, but daily running out looked round about, and went into all the ways by which there seemed any hope he might return, that she might if possible see him coming afar off.
text_la: Illa autem nullo modo consolari poterat, sed quotidie exiliens circumspiciebat, et circuibat vias omnes per quas spes remeandi videbatur, ut procul videret eum, si fieri posset, venientem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ σίγα μὴ πλάνα με ἀπώλετο τὸ παιδίον μου καὶ ἐπορεύετο καθ' ἡμέραν εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν ἔξω οἵας ἀπῆλθεν ἡμέρας τε ἄρτον οὐκ ἤσθιεν τὰς δὲ νύκτας οὐ διελίμπανεν θρηνοῦσα Τωβιαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς ἕως οὗ συνετελέσθησαν αἱ δέκα τέσσαρες ἡμέραι τοῦ γάμου ἃς ὤμοσεν Ραγουηλ ποιῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ εἶπεν δὲ Τωβιας τῷ Ραγουηλ

text_en: But Raguel said to his son in law: Stay here, and I will send a messenger to Tobias your father, that you are in health.
text_la: At vero Raguel dicebat ad generum suum : Mane hic, et ego mittam nuntium salutis de te ad Tobiam patrem tuum.
text_el: ἐξαπόστειλόν με ὅτι ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ ἡ μήτηρ μου οὐκέτι ἐλπίζουσιν ὄψεσθαί με

text_en: And Tobias said to him: I know that my father and mother now count the days, and their spirit is grievously afflicted within them.
text_la: Cui Tobias ait : Ego novi quia pater meus et mater mea modo dies computant, et cruciatur spiritus eorum in ipsis.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ πενθερὸς αὐτοῦ μεῖνον παρ' ἐμοί κἀγὼ ἐξαποστελῶ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ δηλώσουσιν αὐτῷ τὰ κατὰ σέ

text_en: And when Raguel had pressed Tobias with many words, and he by no means would hearken to him, he delivered Sara unto him, and half of all his substance in menservants, and womenservants, in cattle, in camels, and in kine, and in much money, and sent him away safe and joyful from him,
text_la: Cumque verbis multis rogaret Raguel Tobiam, et ille eum nulla ratione vellet audire, tradidit ei Saram, et dimidiam partem omnis substantiæ suæ in pueris, in puellis, in pecudibus, in camelis, et in vaccis, et in pecunia multa : et salvum atque gaudentem dimisit eum a se,
text_el: καὶ Τωβιας λέγει οὐχί ἀλλὰ ἐξαπόστειλόν με πρὸς τὸν πατέρα μου

text_en: saying: The holy angel of the Lord be with you in your journey, and bring you through safe, and that you may find all things well about your parents, and my eyes may see your children before I die.
text_la: dicens : Angelus Domini sanctus sit in itinere vestro, perducatque vos incolumes, et inveniatis omnia recte circa parentes vestros, et videant oculi mei filios vestros priusquam moriar.
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ Ραγουηλ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Σαρραν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ἥμισυ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων σώματα καὶ κτήνη καὶ ἀργύριον

text_en: And the parents taking their daughter kissed her, and let her go:
text_la: Et apprehendentes parentes filiam suam, osculati sunt eam : et dimiserunt ire,
text_el: καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτοὺς ἐξαπέστειλεν λέγων εὐοδώσει ὑμᾶς τέκνα ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πρὸ τοῦ με ἀποθανεῖν

text_en: Admonishing her to honour her father and mother in law, to love her husband, to take care of the family , to govern the house, and to behave herself irreprehensibly.
text_la: monentes eam honorare soceros, diligere maritum, regere familiam, gubernare domum, et seipsam irreprehensibilem exhibere.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ τίμα τοὺς πενθερούς σου αὐτοὶ νῦν γονεῖς σού εἰσιν ἀκούσαιμί σου ἀκοὴν καλήν καὶ ἐφίλησεν αὐτήν καὶ Εδνα εἶπεν πρὸς Τωβιαν ἄδελφε ἀγαπητέ ἀποκαταστήσαι σε ὁ κύριος τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ δῴη μοι ἰδεῖν σου παιδία ἐκ Σαρρας τῆς θυγατρός μου ἵνα εὐφρανθῶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἰδοὺ παρατίθεμαί σοι τὴν θυγατέρα μου ἐν παρακαταθήκῃ μὴ λυπήσῃς αὐτήν

text_en: And as they were returning they came to Charan, which is in the midway to Ninive, the eleventh day.
text_la: Cumque reverterentur, pervenerunt ad Charan, quæ est in medio itinere contra Niniven, undecimo die.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύετο μέχρις οὗ ἐγγίσαι αὐτοὺς εἰς Νινευη

text_en: And the angel said: Brother Tobias, you know how you left your father.
text_la: Dixitque angelus : Tobia frater, scis quemadmodum reliquisti patrem tuum.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ραφαηλ πρὸς Τωβιαν οὐ γινώσκεις ἄδελφε πῶς ἀφῆκας τὸν πατέρα σου

text_en: If it please you therefore, let us go before, and let the family follow softly after us, together with your wife, and with the beasts.
text_la: Si placet itaque tibi, præcedamus, et lento gradu sequantur iter nostrum familiæ, simul cum conjuge tua, et cum animalibus.
text_el: προδράμωμεν ἔμπροσθεν τῆς γυναικός σου καὶ ἑτοιμάσωμεν τὴν οἰκίαν

text_en: And as this their going pleased him, Raphael said to Tobias: Take with you of the gall of the fish, for it will be necessary. So Tobias took some of that gall and departed.
text_la: Cumque hoc placuisset ut irent, dixit Raphaël ad Tobiam : Tolle tecum ex felle piscis : erit enim necessarium. Tulit itaque Tobias ex felle illo, et abierunt.
text_el: λαβὲ δὲ παρὰ χεῖρα τὴν χολὴν τοῦ ἰχθύος καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ συνῆλθεν ὁ κύων ὄπισθεν αὐτῶν

text_en: But Anna sat beside the way daily, on the top of a hill, from whence she might see afar off.
text_la: Anna autem sedebat secus viam quotidie in supercilio montis, unde respicere poterat de longinquo.
text_el: καὶ Αννα ἐκάθητο περιβλεπομένη εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν τὸν παῖδα αὐτῆς

text_en: And while she watched his coming from that place, she saw him afar off, and presently perceived it was her son coming: and returning she told her husband, saying: Behold your son comes.
text_la: Et dum ex eodem loco specularetur adventum ejus, vidit a longe, et illico agnovit venientem filium suum : currensque nuntiavit viro suo, dicens : Ecce venit filius tuus.
text_el: καὶ προσενόησεν αὐτὸν ἐρχόμενον καὶ εἶπεν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἰδοὺ ὁ υἱός σου ἔρχεται καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ πορευθεὶς μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Raphael said to Tobias: As soon as you shall come into your house, forthwith adore the Lord your God : and giving thanks to him, go to your father, and kiss him.
text_la: Dixitque Raphaël ad Tobiam : At ubi introieris domum tuam, statim adora Dominum Deum tuum : et gratias agens ei, accede ad patrem tuum, et osculare eum.
text_el: καὶ Ραφαηλ εἶπεν ἐπίσταμαι ἐγὼ ὅτι ἀνοίξει τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὁ πατήρ σου

text_en: And immediately anoint his eyes with this gall of the fish, which you carry with you. For be assured that his eyes shall be presently opened, and your father shall see the light of heaven , and shall rejoice in the sight of you.
text_la: Statimque lini super oculos ejus ex felle isto piscis, quod portas tecum : scias enim quoniam mox aperientur oculi ejus, et videbit pater tuus lumen cæli, et in aspectu tuo gaudebit.
text_el: σὺ οὖν ἔγχρισον τὴν χολὴν εἰς τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ δηχθεὶς διατρίψει καὶ ἀποβαλεῖ τὰ λευκώματα καὶ ὄψεταί σε

text_en: Then the dog, which had been with them in the way, ran before, and coming as if he had brought the news, showed his joy by his fawning and wagging his tail.
text_la: Tunc præcucurrit canis, qui simul fuerat in via : et quasi nuntius adveniens, blandimento suæ caudæ gaudebat.
text_el: καὶ προσδραμοῦσα Αννα ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εἶδόν σε παιδίον ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἀποθανοῦμαι καὶ ἔκλαυσαν ἀμφότεροι

text_en: And his father that was blind, rising up, began to run stumbling with his feet: and giving a servant his hand, went to meet his son.
text_la: Et consurgens cæcus pater ejus, cœpit offendens pedibus currere : et data manu puero, occurrit obviam filio suo.
text_el: καὶ Τωβιτ ἐξήρχετο πρὸς τὴν θύραν καὶ προσέκοπτεν ὁ δὲ υἱὸς προσέδραμεν αὐτῷ

text_en: And receiving him kissed him, as did also his wife, and they began to weep for joy .
text_la: Et suscipiens osculatus est eum cum uxore sua, et cœperunt ambo flere præ gaudio.
text_el: καὶ ἐπελάβετο τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ προσέπασεν τὴν χολὴν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ λέγων θάρσει πάτερ

text_en: And when they had adored God , and given him thanks, they sat down together.
text_la: Cumque adorassent Deum, et gratias egissent, consederunt.
text_el: ὡς δὲ συνεδήχθησαν διέτριψε τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Tobias taking of the gall of the fish, anointed his father's eyes.
text_la: Tunc sumens Tobias de felle piscis, linivit oculos patris sui.
text_el: καὶ ἐλεπίσθη ἀπὸ τῶν κανθῶν τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ τὰ λευκώματα καὶ ἰδὼν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he stayed about half an hour: and a white skin began to come out of his eyes, like the skin of an egg.
text_la: Et sustinuit quasi dimidiam fere horam : et cœpit albugo ex oculis ejus, quasi membrana ovi, egredi.
text_el: καὶ ἔκλαυσεν καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογητὸς εἶ ὁ θεός καὶ εὐλογητὸν τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας καὶ εὐλογημένοι πάντες οἱ ἅγιοί σου ἄγγελοι

text_en: And Tobias took hold of it, and drew it from his eyes, and recovered his sight.
text_la: Quam apprehendens Tobias, traxit ab oculis ejus : statimque visum recepit.
text_el: ὅτι ἐμαστίγωσας καὶ ἠλέησάς με ἰδοὺ βλέπω Τωβιαν τὸν υἱόν μου καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ χαίρων καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ τὰ μεγαλεῖα τὰ γενόμενα αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ Μηδίᾳ

text_en: And they glorified God , both he and his wife and all that knew him.
text_la: Et glorificabant Deum, ipse videlicet et uxor ejus, et omnes qui sciebant eum.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Τωβιτ εἰς συνάντησιν τῇ νύμφῃ αὐτοῦ χαίρων καὶ εὐλογῶν τὸν θεὸν πρὸς τῇ πύλῃ Νινευη καὶ ἐθαύμαζον οἱ θεωροῦντες αὐτὸν πορευόμενον ὅτι ἔβλεψεν

text_en: And Tobias said: I bless you, O Lord God of Israel , because you have chastised me, and you have saved me and behold I see Tobias my son.
text_la: Dicebatque Tobias : Benedico te, Domine Deus Israël, quia tu castigasti me, et tu salvasti me : et ecce ego video Tobiam filium meum.
text_el: καὶ Τωβιτ ἐξωμολογεῖτο ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ὅτι ἠλέησεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεός καὶ ὡς ἤγγισεν Τωβιτ Σαρρα τῇ νύμφῃ αὐτοῦ κατευλόγησεν αὐτὴν λέγων ἔλθοις ὑγιαίνουσα θύγατερ εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεός ὃς ἤγαγέν σε πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ὁ πατήρ σου καὶ ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ ἐγένετο χαρὰ πᾶσι τοῖς ἐν Νινευη ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And after seven days Sara his son's wife and all the family arrived safe, and the cattle, and the camels, and an abundance of money of his wife's: and that money also which he had received of Gabelus,
text_la: Ingressa est etiam post septem dies Sara uxor filii ejus et omnis familia sana, et pecora, et cameli, et pecunia multa uxoris; sed et illa pecunia, quam receperat a Gabelo.
text_el: καὶ παρεγένετο Αχιαχαρος καὶ Νασβας ὁ ἐξάδελφος αὐτοῦ

text_en: and he told his parents all the benefits of God , which he had done to him by the man that conducted him.
text_la: Et narravit parentibus suis omnia beneficia Dei, quæ fecisset circa eum per hominem qui eum duxerat.
text_el: καὶ ἤχθη ὁ γάμος Τωβια μετ' εὐφροσύνης ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And Achior and Nabath the kinsmen of Tobias came, rejoicing for Tobias, and congratulating with him for all the good things that God had done for him.
text_la: Veneruntque Achior et Nabath consobrini Tobiæ gaudentes ad Tobiam, et congratulantes ei de omnibus bonis quæ circa illum ostenderat Deus.

text_en: And for seven days they feasted and rejoiced all with great joy .
text_la: Et per septem dies epulantes, omnes cum gaudio magno gavisi sunt.

text_en: Then Tobias called to him his son and said to him: What can we give to this holy man , that has come with you?
text_la: Tunc vocavit ad se Tobias filium suum, dixitque ei : Quid possumus dare viro isti sancto, qui venit tecum?
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Τωβιτ Τωβιαν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὅρα τέκνον μισθὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ συνελθόντι σοι καὶ προσθεῖναι αὐτῷ δεῖ

text_en: Tobias answering, said to his father: Father, what wages shall we give him? Or what can be worthy of his benefits?
text_la: Respondens Tobias, dixit patri suo : Pater, quam mercedem dabimus ei? aut quid dignum poterit esse beneficiis ejus?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ πάτερ οὐ βλάπτομαι δοὺς αὐτῷ τὸ ἥμισυ ὧν ἐνήνοχα

text_en: He conducted me and brought me safe again, he received the money of Gabelus, he caused me to have my wife, and he chased from her the evil spirit , he gave joy to her parents, myself he delivered from being devoured by the fish, you also he has made to see the light of heaven , and we are filled with all good things through him. What can we give him sufficient for these things?
text_la: Me duxit et reduxit sanum, pecuniam a Gabelo ipse recepit, uxorem ipse me habere fecit, et dæmonium ab ea ipse compescuit : gaudium parentibus ejus fecit, meipsum a devoratione piscis eripuit, te quoque videre fecit lumen cæli, et bonis omnibus per eum repleti sumus. Quid illi ad hæc poterimus dignum dare?
text_el: ὅτι με ἀγείοχέν σοι ὑγιῆ καὶ τὴν γυναῖκά μου ἐθεράπευσεν καὶ τὸ ἀργύριόν μου ἤνεγκεν καὶ σὲ ὁμοίως ἐθεράπευσεν

text_en: But I beseech you, my father, to desire him, that he would vouchsafe to accept of one half of all things that have been brought.
text_la: Sed peto te, pater mi, ut roges eum, si forte dignabitur medietatem de omnibus quæ allata sunt, sibi assumere.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ πρεσβύτης δικαιοῦται αὐτῷ

text_en: So the father and the son calling him, took him aside: and began to desire him that he would vouchsafe to accept of half of all things that they had brought.
text_la: Et vocantes eum, pater scilicet et filius, tulerunt eum in partem : et rogare cœperunt ut dignaretur dimidiam partem omnium quæ attulerant acceptam habere.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν ἄγγελον καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ λαβὲ τὸ ἥμισυ πάντων ὧν ἐνηνόχατε

text_en: Then he said to them secretly, Bless the God of heaven , give glory to him in the sight of all that live, because he has shown his mercy to you.
text_la: Tunc dixit eis occulte : Benedicite Deum cæli, et coram omnibus viventibus confitemini ei, quia fecit vobiscum misericordiam suam.
text_el: τότε καλέσας τοὺς δύο κρυπτῶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εὐλογεῖτε τὸν θεὸν καὶ αὐτῷ ἐξομολογεῖσθε μεγαλωσύνην δίδοτε αὐτῷ καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθε ἐνώπιον πάντων τῶν ζώντων περὶ ὧν ἐποίησεν μεθ' ὑμῶν ἀγαθὸν τὸ εὐλογεῖν τὸν θεὸν καὶ ὑψοῦν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ τοὺς λόγους τῶν ἔργων τοῦ θεοῦ ἐντίμως ὑποδεικνύοντες καὶ μὴ ὀκνεῖτε ἐξομολογεῖσθαι αὐτῷ

text_en: For it is good to hide the secret of a king: to reveal and confess the works of God .
text_la: Etenim sacramentum regis abscondere bonum est : opera autem Dei revelare et confiteri honorificum est.
text_el: μυστήριον βασιλέως καλὸν κρύψαι τὰ δὲ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνακαλύπτειν ἐνδόξως ἀγαθὸν ποιήσατε καὶ κακὸν οὐχ εὑρήσει ὑμᾶς

text_en: Prayer is good with fasting and alms more than to lay up treasures of gold.
text_la: Bona est oratio cum jejunio, et eleemosyna magis quam thesauros auri recondere:
text_el: ἀγαθὸν προσευχὴ μετὰ νηστείας καὶ ἐλεημοσύνης καὶ δικαιοσύνης ἀγαθὸν τὸ ὀλίγον μετὰ δικαιοσύνης ἢ πολὺ μετὰ ἀδικίας καλὸν ποιῆσαι ἐλεημοσύνην ἢ θησαυρίσαι χρυσίον

text_en: For alms delivers from death, and the same is that which purges away sins , and makes to find mercy and life everlasting.
text_la: quoniam eleemosyna a morte liberat, et ipsa est quæ purgat peccata, et facit invenire misericordiam et viam æternam.
text_el: ἐλεημοσύνη γὰρ ἐκ θανάτου ῥύεται καὶ αὐτὴ ἀποκαθαριεῖ πᾶσαν ἁμαρτίαν οἱ ποιοῦντες ἐλεημοσύνας καὶ δικαιοσύνας πλησθήσονται ζωῆς

text_en: But they that commit sin and iniquity , are enemies to their own soul .
text_la: Qui autem faciunt peccatum et iniquitatem, hostes sunt animæ suæ.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἁμαρτάνοντες πολέμιοί εἰσιν τῆς ἑαυτῶν ζωῆς

text_en: I discover then the truth unto you, and I will not hide the secret from you.
text_la: Manifesto ergo vobis veritatem, et non abscondam a vobis occultum sermonem.
text_el: οὐ μὴ κρύψω ἀφ' ὑμῶν πᾶν ῥῆμα εἴρηκα δή μυστήριον βασιλέως κρύψαι καλόν τὰ δὲ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνακαλύπτειν ἐνδόξως

text_en: When you prayed with tears, and buried the dead, and left your dinner, and hid the dead by day in your house, and buried them by night, I offered your prayer to the Lord .
text_la: Quando orabas cum lacrimis, et sepeliebas mortuos, et derelinquebas prandium tuum, et mortuos abscondebas per diem in domo tua, et nocte sepeliebas eos, ego obtuli orationem tuam Domino.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὅτε προσηύξω σὺ καὶ ἡ νύμφη σου Σαρρα ἐγὼ προσήγαγον τὸ μνημόσυνον τῆς προσευχῆς ὑμῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ὅτε ἔθαπτες τοὺς νεκρούς ὡσαύτως συμπαρήμην σοι

text_en: And because you were acceptable to God , it was necessary that temptation should prove you.
text_la: Et quia acceptus eras Deo, necesse fuit ut tentatio probaret te.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε οὐκ ὤκνησας ἀναστῆναι καὶ καταλιπεῖν τὸ ἄριστόν σου ὅπως ἀπελθὼν περιστείλῃς τὸν νεκρόν οὐκ ἔλαθές με ἀγαθοποιῶν ἀλλὰ σὺν σοὶ ἤμην

text_en: And now the Lord has sent me to heal you, and to deliver Sara your son's wife from the devil .
text_la: Et nunc misit me Dominus ut curarem te, et Saram uxorem filii tui a dæmonio liberarem.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ θεὸς ἰάσασθαί σε καὶ τὴν νύμφην σου Σαρραν

text_en: For I am the angel Raphael, one of the seven, who stand before the Lord .
text_la: Ego enim sum Raphaël angelus, unus ex septem qui adstamus ante Dominum.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι Ραφαηλ εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἁγίων ἀγγέλων οἳ προσαναφέρουσιν τὰς προσευχὰς τῶν ἁγίων καὶ εἰσπορεύονται ἐνώπιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ ἁγίου

text_en: And when they had heard these things, they were troubled, and being seized with fear they fell upon the ground on their face.
text_la: Cumque hæc audissent, turbati sunt, et trementes ceciderunt super terram in faciem suam.
text_el: καὶ ἐταράχθησαν οἱ δύο καὶ ἔπεσον ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ὅτι ἐφοβήθησαν

text_en: And the angel said to them: Peace be to you, fear not.
text_la: Dixitque eis angelus : Pax vobis : nolite timere.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς μὴ φοβεῖσθε εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἔσται τὸν δὲ θεὸν εὐλογεῖτε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: For when I was with you, I was there by the will of God : bless him, and sing praises to him.
text_la: Etenim cum essem vobiscum, per voluntatem Dei eram : ipsum benedicite, et cantate illi.
text_el: ὅτι οὐ τῇ ἐμαυτοῦ χάριτι ἀλλὰ τῇ θελήσει τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἦλθον ὅθεν εὐλογεῖτε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: I seemed indeed to eat and to drink with you but I use an invisible meat and drink, which cannot be seen by men .
text_la: Videbar quidem vobiscum manducare et bibere : sed ego cibo invisibili, et potu qui ab hominibus videri non potest, utor.
text_el: πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ὠπτανόμην ὑμῖν καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγον οὐδὲ ἔπιον ἀλλὰ ὅρασιν ὑμεῖς ἐθεωρεῖτε

text_en: It is time therefore that I return to him that sent me: but bless God , and publish all his wonderful works.
text_la: Tempus est ergo ut revertar ad eum qui me misit : vos autem benedicite Deum, et narrate omnia mirabilia ejus.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ θεῷ διότι ἀναβαίνω πρὸς τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με καὶ γράψατε πάντα τὰ συντελεσθέντα εἰς βιβλίον

text_en: And when he had said these things, he was taken from their sight, and they could see him no more.
text_la: Et cum hæc dixisset, ab aspectu eorum ablatus est, et ultra eum videre non potuerunt.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστησαν καὶ οὐκέτι εἶδον αὐτόν

text_en: Then they lying prostrate for three hours upon their face, blessed God , and rising up, they told all his wonderful works.
text_la: Tunc prostrati per horas tres in faciem, benedixerunt Deum : et exsurgentes narraverunt omnia mirabilia ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἐξωμολογοῦντο τὰ ἔργα τὰ μεγάλα καὶ θαυμαστὰ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ὡς ὤφθη αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου

text_en: And Tobias the elder opening his mouth, blessed the Lord , and said: You are great O Lord , for ever, and your kingdom is unto all ages.
text_la: Aperiens autem Tobias senior os suum, benedixit Dominum, et dixit : Magnus es, Domine, in æternum, et in omnia sæcula regnum tuum :
text_el: καὶ Τωβιτ ἔγραψεν προσευχὴν εἰς ἀγαλλίασιν καὶ εἶπεν

text_en: For you scourge, and you save: you lead down to hell, and bring up again: and there is none that can escape your hand.
text_la: quoniam tu flagellas, et salvas; deducis ad inferos, et reducis : et non est qui effugiat manum tuam.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς ὁ ζῶν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας καὶ ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ ὅτι αὐτὸς μαστιγοῖ καὶ ἐλεᾷ κατάγει εἰς ᾅδην καὶ ἀνάγει καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἐκφεύξεται τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Give glory to the Lord , you children of Israel , and praise him in the sight of the Gentiles :
text_la: Confitemini Domino, filii Israël, et in conspectu gentium laudate eum :
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε αὐτῷ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐθνῶν ὅτι αὐτὸς διέσπειρεν ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Because he has therefore scattered you among the Gentiles , who know not him, that you may declare his wonderful works, and make them know that there is no other almighty God besides him.
text_la: quoniam ideo dispersit vos inter gentes quæ ignorant eum, ut vos enarretis mirabilia ejus, et faciatis scire eos quia non est alius deus omnipotens præter eum.
text_el: ἐκεῖ ὑποδείξατε τὴν μεγαλωσύνην αὐτοῦ ὑψοῦτε αὐτὸν ἐνώπιον παντὸς ζῶντος καθότι αὐτὸς κύριος ἡμῶν καὶ θεός αὐτὸς πατὴρ ἡμῶν εἰς πάντας τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: He has chastised us for our iniquities : and he will save us for his own mercy.
text_la: Ipse castigavit nos propter iniquitates nostras, et ipse salvabit nos propter misericordiam suam.
text_el: καὶ μαστιγώσει ἡμᾶς ἐν ταῖς ἀδικίαις ἡμῶν καὶ πάλιν ἐλεήσει καὶ συνάξει ἡμᾶς ἐκ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν οὗ ἐὰν σκορπισθῆτε ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: See then what he has done with us, and with fear and trembling give glory to him: and extol the eternal King of worlds in your works.
text_la: Aspicite ergo quæ fecit nobiscum, et cum timore et tremore confitemini illi : regemque sæculorum exaltate in operibus vestris.
text_el: ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψητε πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ ποιῆσαι ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἀλήθειαν τότε ἐπιστρέψει πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐ μὴ κρύψῃ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀφ' ὑμῶν

text_en: As for me, I will praise him in the land of my captivity: because he has shown his majesty toward a sinful nation,
text_la: Ego autem in terra captivitatis meæ confitebor illi : quoniam ostendit majestatem suam in gentem peccatricem.
text_el: καὶ θεάσασθε ἃ ποιήσει μεθ' ὑμῶν καὶ ἐξομολογήσασθε αὐτῷ ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ στόματι ὑμῶν καὶ εὐλογήσατε τὸν κύριον τῆς δικαιοσύνης καὶ ὑψώσατε τὸν βασιλέα τῶν αἰώνων

text_en: be converted therefore, you sinners, and do justice before God , believing that he will show his mercy to you.
text_la: Convertimini itaque peccatores, et facite justitiam coram Deo, credentes quod faciat vobiscum misericordiam suam.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἐν τῇ γῇ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας μου ἐξομολογοῦμαι αὐτῷ καὶ δεικνύω τὴν ἰσχὺν καὶ τὴν μεγαλωσύνην αὐτοῦ ἔθνει ἁμαρτωλῶν ἐπιστρέψατε ἁμαρτωλοί καὶ ποιήσατε δικαιοσύνην ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ τίς γινώσκει εἰ θελήσει ὑμᾶς καὶ ποιήσει ἐλεημοσύνην ὑμῖν

text_en: And I and my soul will rejoice in him.
text_la: Ego autem et anima mea in eo lætabimur.
text_el: τὸν θεόν μου ὑψῶ καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν βασιλέα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσεται τὴν μεγαλωσύνην αὐτοῦ

text_en: Bless the Lord , all his elect , keep days of joy , and give glory to him.
text_la: Benedicite Dominum omnes electi ejus : agite dies lætitiæ, et confitemini illi.
text_el: λεγέτωσαν πάντες καὶ ἐξομολογείσθωσαν αὐτῷ ἐν Ιεροσολύμοις Ιεροσόλυμα πόλις ἁγία μαστιγώσει ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν υἱῶν σου καὶ πάλιν ἐλεήσει τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν δικαίων

text_en: Jerusalem , city of God , the Lord has chastised you for the works of your hands.
text_la: Jerusalem civitas Dei, castigavit te Dominus in operibus manuum tuarum.
text_el: ἐξομολογοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἀγαθῶς καὶ εὐλόγει τὸν βασιλέα τῶν αἰώνων ἵνα πάλιν ἡ σκηνὴ αὐτοῦ οἰκοδομηθῇ σοι μετὰ χαρᾶς

text_en: Give glory to the Lord for your good things, and bless the God eternal that he may rebuild his tabernacle in you, and may call back all the captives to you, and you may rejoice for ever and ever.
text_la: Confitere Domino in bonis tuis, et benedic Deum sæculorum : ut reædificet in te tabernaculum suum, et revocet ad te omnes captivos, et gaudeas in omnia sæcula sæculorum.
text_el: καὶ εὐφράναι ἐν σοὶ τοὺς αἰχμαλώτους καὶ ἀγαπήσαι ἐν σοὶ τοὺς ταλαιπώρους εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: You shall shine with a glorious light: and all the ends of the earth shall worship you,
text_la: Luce splendida fulgebis, et omnes fines terræ adorabunt te.
text_el: ἔθνη πολλὰ μακρόθεν ἥξει πρὸς τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ δῶρα ἐν χερσὶν ἔχοντες καὶ δῶρα τῷ βασιλεῖ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ γενεαὶ γενεῶν δώσουσίν σοι ἀγαλλίαμα

text_en: nations from afar shall come to you: and shall bring gifts, and shall adore the Lord in you, and shall esteem your land as holy .
text_la: Nationes ex longinquo ad te venient, et munera deferentes adorabunt in te Dominum, et terram tuam in sanctificationem habebunt :
text_el: ἐπικατάρατοι πάντες οἱ μισοῦντές σε εὐλογημένοι ἔσονται πάντες οἱ ἀγαπῶντές σε εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: For they shall call upon the great name in you,
text_la: nomen enim magnum invocabunt in te.
text_el: χάρηθι καὶ ἀγαλλίασαι ἐπὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν δικαίων ὅτι συναχθήσονται καὶ εὐλογήσουσιν τὸν κύριον τῶν δικαίων ὦ μακάριοι οἱ ἀγαπῶντές σε χαρήσονται ἐπὶ τῇ εἰρήνῃ σου

text_en: they shall be cursed that shall despise you: and they shall be condemned that shall blaspheme you: and blessed shall they be that shall build you up,
text_la: Maledicti erunt qui contempserint te, et condemnati erunt omnes qui blasphemaverint te : benedictique erunt qui ædificaverint te.
text_el: μακάριοι ὅσοι ἐλυπήθησαν ἐπὶ πάσαις ταῖς μάστιξίν σου ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ χαρήσονται θεασάμενοι πᾶσαν τὴν δόξαν σου καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἡ ψυχή μου εὐλογείτω τὸν θεὸν τὸν βασιλέα τὸν μέγαν

text_en: but you shall rejoice in your children, because they shall all be blessed , and shall be gathered together to the Lord .
text_la: Tu autem lætaberis in filiis tuis, quoniam omnes benedicentur, et congregabuntur ad Dominum.
text_el: ὅτι οἰκοδομηθήσεται Ιερουσαλημ σαπφείρῳ καὶ σμαράγδῳ καὶ λίθῳ ἐντίμῳ τὰ τείχη σου καὶ οἱ πύργοι καὶ οἱ προμαχῶνες ἐν χρυσίῳ καθαρῷ καὶ αἱ πλατεῖαι Ιερουσαλημ βηρύλλῳ καὶ ἄνθρακι καὶ λίθῳ ἐκ Σουφιρ ψηφολογηθήσονται

text_en: Blessed are all they that love you, and that rejoice in your peace,
text_la: Beati omnes qui diligunt te, et qui gaudent super pace tua.
text_el: καὶ ἐροῦσιν πᾶσαι αἱ ῥῦμαι αὐτῆς αλληλουια καὶ αἰνέσουσιν λέγοντες εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεός ὃς ὕψωσεν πάντας τοὺς αἰῶνας

text_en: my soul , bless the Lord , because the Lord our God has delivered Jerusalem his city from all her troubles.
text_la: Anima mea, benedic Dominum, quoniam liberavit Jerusalem civitatem suam a cunctis tribulationibus ejus Dominus Deus noster.

text_en: Happy shall I be if there shall remain of my seed, to see the glory of Jerusalem .
text_la: Beatus ero si fuerint reliquiæ seminis mei ad videndam claritatem Jerusalem.

text_en: The gates of Jerusalem shall be built of sapphire, and of emerald, and all the walls thereof round about of precious stones .
text_la: Portæ Jerusalem ex sapphiro et smaragdo ædificabuntur, et ex lapide pretioso omnis circuitus murorum ejus.

text_en: All its streets shall be paved with white and clean stones: and Alleluia shall be sung in its streets,
text_la: Ex lapide candido et mundo omnes plateæ ejus sternentur, et per vicos ejus alleluja cantabitur.

text_en: blessed be the Lord , who has exalted it, and may he reign over it for ever and ever, Amen .
text_la: Benedictus Dominus, qui exaltavit eam, et sit regnum ejus in sæcula sæculorum super eam. Amen.

text_en: And the words of Tobias were ended. And after Tobias was restored to his sight, he lived two and forty years, and saw the children of his grandchildren.
text_la: Et consummati sunt sermones Tobiæ. Et postquam illuminatus est Tobias, vixit annis quadraginta duobus, et vidit filios nepotum suorum.
text_el: καὶ ἐπαύσατο ἐξομολογούμενος Τωβιτ

text_en: And after he had lived a hundred and two years, he was buried honorably in Ninive.
text_la: Completis itaque annis centum duobus, sepultus est honorifice in Ninive.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ἐτῶν πεντήκοντα ὀκτώ ὅτε ἀπώλεσεν τὰς ὄψεις καὶ μετὰ ἔτη ὀκτὼ ἀνέβλεψεν καὶ ἐποίει ἐλεημοσύνας καὶ προσέθετο φοβεῖσθαι κύριον τὸν θεὸν καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι αὐτῷ

text_en: For he was six and fifty years old when he lost the sight of his eyes, and sixty when he recovered it again.
text_la: Quinquaginta namque et sex annorum lumen oculorum amisit, sexagenarius vero recepit.
text_el: μεγάλως δὲ ἐγήρασεν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τέκνον λαβὲ τοὺς υἱούς σου ἰδοὺ γεγήρακα καὶ πρὸς τὸ ἀποτρέχειν ἐκ τοῦ ζῆν εἰμι

text_en: And the rest of his life was in joy , and with great increase of the fear of God he departed in peace.
text_la: Reliquum vero vitæ suæ in gaudio fuit, et cum bono profectu timoris Dei perrexit in pace.
text_el: ἄπελθε εἰς τὴν Μηδίαν τέκνον ὅτι πέπεισμαι ὅσα ἐλάλησεν Ιωνας ὁ προφήτης περὶ Νινευη ὅτι καταστραφήσεται ἐν δὲ τῇ Μηδίᾳ ἔσται εἰρήνη μᾶλλον ἕως καιροῦ καὶ ὅτι οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ γῇ σκορπισθήσονται ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγαθῆς γῆς καὶ Ιεροσόλυμα ἔσται ἔρημος καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῇ κατακαήσεται καὶ ἔρημος ἔσται μέχρι χρόνου

text_en: And at the hour of his death he called unto him his son Tobias and his children, seven young men, his grandsons, and said to them:
text_la: In hora autem mortis suæ vocavit ad se Tobiam filium suum, et septem juvenes filios ejus nepotes suos, dixitque eis:
text_el: καὶ πάλιν ἐλεήσει αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἐπιστρέψει αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν τὸν οἶκον οὐχ οἷος ὁ πρότερος ἕως πληρωθῶσιν καιροὶ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐκ τῶν αἰχμαλωσιῶν καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν Ιερουσαλημ ἐντίμως καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῇ οἰκοδομηθήσεται εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος οἰκοδομῇ ἐνδόξῳ καθὼς ἐλάλησαν περὶ αὐτῆς οἱ προφῆται

text_en: The destruction of Ninive is at hand: for the word of the Lord must be fulfilled: and our brethren, that are scattered abroad from the land of Israel , shall return to it.
text_la: Prope erit interitus Ninive : non enim excidit verbum Domini : et fratres nostri, qui dispersi sunt a terra Israël, revertentur ad eam.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἀληθινῶς φοβεῖσθαι κύριον τὸν θεὸν καὶ κατορύξουσιν τὰ εἴδωλα αὐτῶν καὶ εὐλογήσουσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὸν κύριον

text_en: And all the land thereof that is desert shall be filled with people, and the house of God which is burnt in it, shall again be rebuilt: and all that fear God shall return thither.
text_la: Omnis autem deserta terra ejus replebitur, et domus Dei, quæ in ea incensa est, iterum reædificabitur : ibique revertentur omnes timentes Deum,
text_el: καὶ ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογήσεται τῷ θεῷ καὶ ὑψώσει κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ χαρήσονται πάντες οἱ ἀγαπῶντες κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ ποιοῦντες ἔλεος τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἡμῶν

text_en: And the Gentiles shall leave their idols, and shall come into Jerusalem , and shall dwell in it.
text_la: et relinquent gentes idola sua, et venient in Jerusalem, et inhabitabunt in ea:
text_el: καὶ νῦν τέκνον ἄπελθε ἀπὸ Νινευη ὅτι πάντως ἔσται ἃ ἐλάλησεν ὁ προφήτης Ιωνας

text_en: And all the kings of the earth shall rejoice in it, adoring the King of Israel .
text_la: et gaudebunt in ea omnes reges terræ, adorantes regem Israël.
text_el: σὺ δὲ τήρησον τὸν νόμον καὶ τὰ προστάγματα καὶ γίνου φιλελεήμων καὶ δίκαιος ἵνα σοι καλῶς ᾖ καὶ θάψον με καλῶς καὶ τὴν μητέρα σου μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ μηκέτι αὐλισθῆτε εἰς Νινευη

text_en: Hearken therefore, my children, to your father: serve the Lord in truth , and seek to do the things that please him:
text_la: Audite ergo, filii mei, patrem vestrum : servite Domino in veritate, et inquirite ut faciatis quæ placita sunt illi:
text_el: τέκνον ἰδὲ τί ἐποίησεν Αμαν Αχιαχάρῳ τῷ θρέψαντι αὐτόν ὡς ἐκ τοῦ φωτὸς ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σκότος καὶ ὅσα ἀνταπέδωκεν αὐτῷ καὶ Αχιαχαρος μὲν ἐσώθη ἐκείνῳ δὲ τὸ ἀνταπόδομα ἀπεδόθη καὶ αὐτὸς κατέβη εἰς τὸ σκότος Μανασσης ἐποίησεν ἐλεημοσύνην καὶ ἐσώθη ἐκ παγίδος θανάτου ἧς ἔπηξεν αὐτῷ Αμαν δὲ ἐνέπεσεν εἰς τὴν παγίδα καὶ ἀπώλετο

text_en: And command your children that they do justice and almsdeeds , and that they be mindful of God , and bless him at all times in truth , and with all their power.
text_la: et filiis vestris mandate ut faciant justitias et eleemosynas, ut sint memores Dei, et benedicant eum in omni tempore in veritate, et in tota virtute sua.
text_el: καὶ νῦν παιδία ἴδετε τί ἐλεημοσύνη ποιεῖ καὶ τί δικαιοσύνη ῥύεται καὶ ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ἐξέλιπεν αὐτοῦ ἡ ψυχὴ ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης ἦν δὲ ἐτῶν ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα ὀκτώ καὶ ἔθαψεν αὐτὸν ἐνδόξως

text_en: And now, children, hear me, and do not stay here: but as soon as you shall bury your mother by me in one sepulchre, without delay direct your steps to depart hence:
text_la: Nunc ergo filii, audite me, et nolite manere hic : sed quacumque die sepelieritis matrem vestram circa me in uno sepulchro, ex eo dirigite gressus vestros ut exeatis hinc:
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἀπέθανεν Αννα ἔθαψεν αὐτὴν μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθεν δὲ Τωβιας μετὰ τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ εἰς Ἐκβάτανα πρὸς Ραγουηλ τὸν πενθερὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: For I see that its iniquity will bring it to destruction.
text_la: video enim quia iniquitas ejus finem dabit ei.
text_el: καὶ ἐγήρασεν ἐντίμως καὶ ἔθαψεν τοὺς πενθεροὺς αὐτοῦ ἐνδόξως καὶ ἐκληρονόμησεν τὴν οὐσίαν αὐτῶν καὶ Τωβιτ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it came to pass that after the death of his mother, Tobias departed out of Ninive with his wife, and children, and children's children, and returned to his father and mother in law.
text_la: Factum est autem post obitum matris suæ, Tobias abscessit ex Ninive cum uxore sua, et filiis, et filiorum filiis, et reversus est ad soceros suos:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐτῶν ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ἑπτὰ ἐν Ἐκβατάνοις τῆς Μηδίας

text_en: And he found them in health in a good old age: and he took care of them, and he closed their eyes: and all the inheritance of Raguel's house came to him: and he saw his children's children to the fifth generation .
text_la: invenitque eos incolumes in senectute bona : et curam eorum gessit, et ipse clausit oculos eorum : et omnem hæreditatem domus Raguelis ipse percepit : viditque quintam generationem, filios filiorum suorum.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν πρὶν ἢ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτὸν τὴν ἀπώλειαν Νινευη ἣν ᾐχμαλώτισεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ καὶ Ασυηρος ἐχάρη πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν ἐπὶ Νινευη

text_en: And after he had lived ninety-nine years in the fear of the Lord , with joy they buried him.
text_la: Et completis annis nonaginta novem in timore Domini, cum gaudio sepelierunt eum.

text_en: And all his kindred, and all his generation continued in good life, and in holy conversation, so that they were acceptable both to God , and to men , and to all that dwelt in the land.
text_la: Omnis autem cognatio ejus et omnis generatio ejus in bona vita et in sancta conversatione permansit, ita ut accepti essent tam Deo quam hominibus, et cunctis habitantibus in terra.
